function kb11Torso(m,low,high,waist,shoulder,depthLow,depthHi,color){
  const sides=10,ring=(y,rx,rz,k)=>[Math.cos(k*TAU/sides)*rx,y,Math.sin(k*TAU/sides)*rz];
  for(let k=0;k<sides;k++){
    const a=ring(low,waist,depthLow,k),b=ring(low,waist,depthLow,k+1),c=ring(high,shoulder,depthHi,k+1),d=ring(high,shoulder,depthHi,k);
    m.quad(a,b,c,d,color,3);
  }
  m.quad([-.18,low,depthLow*.83],[.18,low,depthLow*.83],[.18,low,-depthLow*.83],[-.18,low,-depthLow*.83],color,3);
}
function kb11Line(m,a,b,r,col){roundBone(m,a,b,r,col,r*.9,0,5)}
function kb11Flower(m,x,y,z,s){
  const c='#17191c';
  for(let k=0;k<5;k++){
    const a=k*TAU/5,xp=x+Math.cos(a)*s*.45,yp=y+Math.sin(a)*s*.45;
    m.sphere(xp,yp,z,.43*s,.40*s,.008,c);
  }
  m.sphere(x,y,z+.009,.27*s,.27*s,.007,'#f4f2ee');
}
function kb11Shoe(m,x,y,z,skin,sole){
  m.box(x,y+.038,z+.067,.195,.107,.32,skin,3);
  m.box(x,y-.010,z+.07,.210,.030,.332,sole,3);
  m.box(x,y+.063,z+.177,.15,.023,.077,'#dedfe0',3);
  for(let j=0;j<3;j++)m.rod([x-.044,y+.103,z+.032+j*.043],[x+.044,y+.103,z+.032+j*.043],.010,'#858b8b');
  for(const q of [-1,1])kb11Swoosh(m,x+q*.0995,y+.045,z+.07,.05,'#1b1b1d',1);
}
const KB11DBL=true;
function kb11Swoosh(m,x,y,z,s,col,ax){
  const P=(u,v)=>ax?[x,y+v*s,z+u*s]:[x+u*s,y+v*s,z],A=P(-1,.22),B=P(-.2,-.48),C=P(1,.55),D=P(-.1,-.18),E=P(-.78,.2);
  for(const t of [[A,B,D],[B,C,D],[A,D,E]]){m.tri(t[0],t[1],t[2],col,3);if(KB11DBL)m.tri(t[0],t[2],t[1],col,3)}
}
function kb11Head(b,who,pose,near,walking){
  const h=Mesh(),sk=who.skin,sh=who.skinShade||'#c99179',ey=who.eyes,dark=who.hair,F=.155,P=who.style==='maroonPolo',A=who.style==='flowers';
  h.sphere(0,0,0,.168,.215,.159,sk);h.sphere(0,-.105,.045,.128,.095,.118,sk);h.sphere(0,-.168,.078,.05,.034,.048,sk);
  for(const s of [-1,1]){h.sphere(s*.162,-.011,0,.035,.060,.045,sk);h.sphere(s*.167,-.012,.012,.017,.040,.022,sh);h.sphere(s*.105,-.048,.117,.05,.044,.04,sk)}
  h.box(0,.008,F+.012,.022,.075,.03,sk);h.sphere(0,-.03,F+.028,.026,.021,.026,sh);
  for(const s of [-1,1])h.sphere(s*.016,-.037,F+.031,.009,.007,.008,'#6d4639');
  for(const s of [-1,1]){const x=s*.075;
    h.box(x,P?.076:.067,F+.011,.07,P?.011:.018,.014,dark);
    h.sphere(x,.025,F+.007,.037,.019,.012,'#efe8de');h.sphere(x+s*.002,.025,F+.02,.015,.016,.008,ey);h.sphere(x+s*.002,.025,F+.027,.007,.007,.005,'#0c0c0c');
    h.box(x,.046,F+.016,.07,.006,.01,'#2c211d');if(near)h.sphere(x+.012,.031,F+.032,.004,.004,.003,'#fff')}
  const my=-.09,lip='#b4685f';
  if(P){h.box(0,my,F+.006,.105,.017,.012,'#f3efe8');h.box(0,my-.011,F+.008,.112,.007,.012,lip);h.box(0,my+.01,F+.008,.112,.005,.012,'#7a403d');for(const s of [-1,1])h.box(s*.058,my+.013,F+.003,.02,.014,.012,lip)}
  else if(A){h.box(-.006,my,F+.011,.075,.011,.012,lip);h.box(.044,my+.008,F+.009,.03,.009,.012,lip);h.box(-.006,my-.009,F+.01,.058,.008,.012,'#a55c55')}
  else{h.box(0,my,F+.011,.07,.009,.012,lip);h.box(0,my-.009,F+.01,.054,.009,.012,'#a35d56')}
  if(pose.talk){
    const open=.019+Math.abs(Math.sin(time*12.3))*.029;
    h.box(0,-.089,F+.031,.080,open,.014,'#2e1a1b',3);
    h.box(0,-.089-open*.56,F+.033,.066,.007,.016,'#d38b82',3);
  }
  if(who.hairStyle==='fringe'){
    h.sphere(0,.178,-.02,.185,.105,.17,dark);h.sphere(-.09,.205,.01,.09,.07,.11,'#3f2e24');h.sphere(.07,.21,.02,.1,.07,.11,'#2c2018');
    [[-.105,.152,.115,.058],[-.04,.168,.13,.062],[.03,.172,.134,.062],[.095,.155,.12,.058]].forEach(p=>h.sphere(p[0],p[1],p[2],p[3],.045,.05,dark));
    for(const s of [-1,1])h.sphere(s*.153,.05,.03,.034,.082,.075,dark);h.sphere(0,.04,-.12,.15,.15,.07,dark);
  }else if(who.hairStyle==='crop'){
    h.sphere(0,.168,-.01,.174,.07,.166,dark);h.sphere(0,.19,.02,.15,.05,.14,'#2a231f');h.box(0,.142,.1,.26,.04,.09,'#1c1815');
    for(const s of [-1,1])h.sphere(s*.152,.07,0,.03,.075,.08,dark);
  }else{
    h.sphere(0,.166,-.02,.172,.05,.155,dark);h.box(0,.147,.105,.225,.024,.06,'#2d2823');for(const s of [-1,1])h.sphere(s*.15,.075,0,.026,.07,.07,dark);
  }
  if(P){for(const s of [-1,1]){const x=s*.077,fw=.092,fh=.06,z=.193;
    for(const sy of [-1,1])kb11Line(h,[x-fw/2,sy*fh/2+.023,z],[x+fw/2,sy*fh/2+.023,z],.0085,'#171a1f');
    for(const sx of [-1,1])kb11Line(h,[x+sx*fw/2,.023-fh/2,z],[x+sx*fw/2,.023+fh/2,z],.0085,'#171a1f');
    kb11Line(h,[s*.126,.026,z-.014],[s*.184,.009,z-.038],.007,'#24262c')}
    kb11Line(h,[-.034,.028,.194],[.034,.028,.194],.006,'#1b1b1f')}
  return h.out;
}
function gripWorld(local,a,Y,lean,tilt,scale){
 const [x,y,z]=local.map(v=>v*scale),xx=x*Math.cos(lean)-y*Math.sin(lean),yy=x*Math.sin(lean)+y*Math.cos(lean),
   zz=-yy*Math.sin(tilt)+z*Math.cos(tilt),co=Math.cos(a.yaw||0),si=Math.sin(a.yaw||0);
 return [a.x+xx*co+zz*si,Y+yy*Math.cos(tilt)+z*Math.sin(tilt),a.z-xx*si+zz*co];
}
function flashlightRig(m,p,first){
 const moving=r2Reduced?0:clamp((p.move||0)*.19,0,1),turn=r2Reduced?0:motion.turn;
 const ang=yaw-turn*.038+moving*.009*Math.sin(p.phase),elev=pitch-.025+moving*.011*Math.cos(p.phase*2);
 const dir=[Math.sin(ang)*Math.cos(elev),Math.sin(elev),Math.cos(ang)*Math.cos(elev)],right=[Math.cos(yaw),0,-Math.sin(yaw)],
 up=[-Math.sin(yaw)*Math.sin(pitch),Math.cos(pitch),-Math.cos(yaw)*Math.sin(pitch)];
 const L=lampLevel();if(L<.02)return;
 const start=first?cam.eye.map((v,i)=>v+dir[i]*.31+right[i]*.205-up[i]*(.19+(1-L)*.62)+right[i]*(1-L)*.12):motion.hand;
 if(!start)return;
 const at=t=>start.map((v,i)=>v+dir[i]*t);
 if(first){const wrist=start.map((v,i)=>v-right[i]*.044-up[i]*.04);roundBone(m,wrist.map((v,i)=>v-dir[i]*.24+right[i]*.061-up[i]*.045),wrist,.070,KB_HERO_11[active].shirt,.052,0,8);
   m.sphere(...wrist,.059,.050,.052,CREW_ROLES[active].skin);}
 roundBone(m,at(-.07),at(.12),.038,'#435054',.041,0,10);roundBone(m,at(.11),at(.18),.042,'#292e32',.062,0,12);
 roundBone(m,at(.18),at(.195),.060,'#919996',.055,0,12);roundBone(m,at(.195),at(.201),.049,torch?'#f2e6bd':'#626d69',.049,torch?11:10,12);
 motion.lens={pos:at(.213),dir};
}
function kb11Model(m,a,i,footballer=false){
  if(footballer){humanDetailed(m,a,i,footballer);return} // Football mode has its own team kits.
  const role=window.KBRewardsA2.role(KB_HERO_11[i%3],i%3),player=actors[active],dist=a.kb11Cine?0:(player?distance(player,a):0);
  if(dist>82){humanDetailed(m,a,i,false);return} // fast distant LOD
  const near=quality>=2&&dist<28,ultra=quality>=3&&dist<18;
  const b=Mesh(),pose=actorPose(a,i),move=clamp((a.move||0)/4.5,0,1),run=pose.run,
        ph=pose.phase||0,sw=Math.sin(ph),cs=Math.cos(ph),stride=(.32+.20*run)*move,
        bob=(.012*Math.sin((time||0)*2+i)+Math.abs(cs)*(.026+.035*run)*move),
        riding=!!(!a.kb11Cine&&i===active&&ride.kind),crouch=!!(!a.kb11Cine&&i===active&&cine?.crouch),
        stance=riding?.77:.91-(!a.kb11Cine&&i===active?.245*motion.stance:0),shirt=role.shirt,pants=role.pants,sk=role.skin,
        shoulder=1.46,headY=1.716;
  const socks=role.style==='blackSport',lowerFabric=socks?'#eeecea':pants;
  // Legs: independent upper/lower segments, alternating foot lifts and more bend during a sprint.
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    const x=side*.134,phaseLeg=sw*side,forward=stride*phaseLeg;
    const lift=!riding&&phaseLeg>0?Math.pow(phaseLeg,1.25)*(.14+.055*run)*move:0;
    const knee=[x,stance-.40+Math.max(0,lift)*.40,forward*.53],ankle=[x+.012*side,.115+lift,riding?(side===1?.4:-.07):forward];
    if(socks){
      kb11Line(b,[x,stance,0],knee,.106,pants);
      kb11Line(b,knee,[x,.24+lift,ankle[2]],.072,sk);
      kb11Line(b,[x,.24+lift,ankle[2]],ankle,.078,lowerFabric);
      b.box(x,stance-.31,knee[2],.22,.40,.22,pants,3);
      b.box(x,stance-.52,knee[2],.225,.020,.23,'#192130',3);
    }else{
      kb11Line(b,[x,stance,0],knee,.105,pants);
      kb11Line(b,knee,ankle,.082,pants);
      if(near){b.box(x,stance-.25,forward*.25,.12,.18,.018,'#2f343b',3)}
    }
    if(role.style==='flowers'){
      b.box(x+side*.098,stance-.33,forward*.30,.022,.57,.018,'#e5e5e6',3);
    }
    if(role.style==='maroonPolo'&&near){
      const cx=x+side*.09;b.box(cx,stance-.23,forward*.17,.055,.18,.030,'#24282d',3);
      b.box(cx,stance-.26,forward*.17+.024,.044,.011,.009,'#69717a',3);
    }
    if(role.style==='flowers'){if(side===1)kb11Swoosh(b,x+.01,stance-.13,forward*.265+.109,.05,'#f2f2f2');kb11Line(b,[x,.21+lift,ankle[2]-.01],ankle,.092,'#15161a')}
    if(socks&&side===1)kb11Swoosh(b,x+.01,stance-.38,forward*.265+.108,.04,'#e9e9ea');
    kb11Shoe(b,ankle[0],ankle[1],ankle[2],role.shoe,role.sole);
  }
  // Main torso, neck and shirt. Both mesh surfaces and colors are procedural (no network fetch).
  b.sphere(0,stance+.065,0,.240,.175,.157,pants);
  kb11Torso(b,stance+.025,shoulder+bob,.230,.302,.157,.200,shirt);
  b.box(0,shoulder+.008+bob,0,.12,.130,.13,sk,3);
  b.box(0,stance+.01,.014,.39,.065,.30,pants,3);
  if(role.style==='flowers'){
    b.box(0,stance+.025,.158,.43,.027,.018,'#ecebe8',3);
    if(near){
      [[-.202,1.390,.067],[-.145,1.264,.074],[.166,1.323,.065],[.192,1.15,.06],[-.08,1.03,.068]].forEach(p=>kb11Flower(b,p[0],p[1]+bob,p[2]+.18,p[2]));
    }else{
      for(const [x,y] of [[-.18,1.37],[.16,1.27],[-.09,1.1]])b.box(x,y+bob,.198,.097,.095,.012,'#252426',3);
    }
    // T-shirt open neck + ribbed collar seam.
    b.sphere(0,1.472+bob,.028,.160,.035,.139,'#e2e2dc');
  }else if(role.style==='blackSport'){
    b.sphere(0,1.475+bob,.018,.137,.035,.13,'#2c2c30');
    // White curved sport mark, geometric and not a fetched brand asset.
    kb11Swoosh(b,0,1.285+bob,.192,.115,'#f4f4f4');for(const q of [-1,1])kb11Line(b,[q*.02,stance+.01,.16],[q*.034,stance-.1,.17],.008,'#f1f1f1');b.box(0,stance+.012,.162,.05,.016,.02,'#f1f1f1',3);
    
  }else{
    // Maroon polo: collar, button placket, pale wreath emblem on chest.
    b.tri([-.15,1.455+bob,.165],[-.018,1.44+bob,.221],[-.11,1.322+bob,.216],'#b95560',3);
    b.tri([.15,1.455+bob,.165],[.018,1.44+bob,.221],[.11,1.322+bob,.216],'#b95560',3);
    b.box(0,1.345+bob,.209,.019,.135,.012,'#57262e',3);
    for(let j=0;j<3;j++)b.box(0,1.36-j*.043+bob,.221,.011,.011,.009,'#e4d1ce',3);
    for(const side of [-1,1])for(let j=0;j<4;j++){
      const x=.148+side*(j*.008),y=1.35+j*.016+bob;
      b.rod([x,y,.210],[x+.016,y+.024,.206],.006,'#e2dbd4');
    }
    // Messenger bag and sling: a moving character accessory, independent of gameplay inventory.
    kb11Line(b,[-.28,1.44+bob,-.03],[.245,.94,.16],.019,'#15171d');
    b.box(.285,.895,.05,.27,.26,.16,'#15171c',3);
    b.box(.285,.875,.139,.232,.11,.016,'#23252b',3);
    b.box(.285,.938,.139,.048,.028,.020,'#8b8b87',3);
    if(ultra)for(let k=0;k<3;k++)b.box(.21+k*.075,.81,.15,.010,.014,.007,'#303236',3);
    // Shoulder jumper over one shoulder, matching the reference without using its photograph.
    b.sphere(.29,1.48+bob,-.082,.16,.16,.17,'#25272c');
    b.box(.32,1.315+bob,-.176,.20,.32,.07,'#24262c',3);
  }
  // Arm swing counterbalances leg swing, smooth at idle and run.
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    const upper=[side*.303,1.432+bob,0], swingZ=-sw*side*move*(.22+run*.17),
          pk=role.style!=='maroonPolo'&&move<.1&&!riding&&!crouch,
          elbow=pk?[side*.372,1.17+bob,-.05]:[side*(.370+.015*run),1.186+bob,swingZ*.60+.006],
          wrist=pk?[side*.215,stance-.1,.035]:[side*(.377+.03*run),.948+bob,swingZ*1.12+.034];
    if(a.kb11Cine){
      const act=a.kb11Action||'idle',speaking=pose.talk,talking=(act==='talk'||speaking);
      if((talking&&side===1)||act==='laugh'||act==='proud'){
        elbow[1]=1.22+bob;elbow[2]=.19;
        wrist[0]=side*(act==='laugh'?.48:.29);
        wrist[1]=act==='laugh'?1.57+bob:1.33+bob+Math.sin(time*7)*.09;
        wrist[2]=.38+Math.sin(time*4+side)*.065;
      }
      if(act==='phone'&&side===1){elbow[1]=1.32+bob;elbow[2]=.22;wrist[0]=.19;wrist[1]=1.42+bob;wrist[2]=.46;}
      if(act==='pool'&&side===1){elbow[1]=1.16+bob;elbow[2]=.38;wrist[0]=.30;wrist[1]=1.18+bob;wrist[2]=.68;}
      if(act==='nervous'){wrist[1]=1.17+bob;wrist[2]=.17;}
      {const T=time||0,o1=Math.sin(T*7+i),o2=Math.sin(T*4.3+i*2);
       if(act==='tease'){if(side===1){elbow[0]=.40;elbow[1]=1.26+bob;elbow[2]=.22;wrist[0]=.21;wrist[1]=1.42+bob+o1*.03;wrist[2]=.64}else{elbow[0]=-.47;elbow[1]=1.10+bob;elbow[2]=-.02;wrist[0]=-.25;wrist[1]=.99+bob;wrist[2]=.06}}
       else if(act==='laugh'){elbow[0]=side*.37;elbow[1]=1.12+bob;elbow[2]=.12;wrist[0]=side*.12;wrist[1]=1.04+bob+Math.abs(Math.sin(T*9+i))*.06;wrist[2]=.27}
       else if(act==='angry'){elbow[0]=side*.36;elbow[1]=1.10+bob;elbow[2]=.16;wrist[0]=side*.27;wrist[1]=.98+bob+o1*.025;wrist[2]=.42}
       else if(act==='nervous'){if(side===1){elbow[0]=.34;elbow[1]=1.50+bob;elbow[2]=-.02;wrist[0]=.10;wrist[1]=1.70+bob+o2*.02;wrist[2]=-.05}else{elbow[0]=-.36;elbow[1]=1.12+bob;elbow[2]=.10;wrist[0]=-.22;wrist[1]=1.02+bob;wrist[2]=.22}}
       else if(act==='serious'){elbow[0]=side*.30;elbow[1]=1.12+bob;elbow[2]=.16;wrist[0]=-side*.14;wrist[1]=1.17+bob;wrist[2]=.31}
       else if(act==='shrug'){elbow[0]=side*.50;elbow[1]=1.20+bob;elbow[2]=.10;wrist[0]=side*.60;wrist[1]=1.36+bob+Math.max(0,o2)*.04;wrist[2]=.30}
       else if(act==='think'){if(side===1){elbow[0]=.22;elbow[1]=1.22+bob;elbow[2]=.20;wrist[0]=.06;wrist[1]=1.52+bob;wrist[2]=.28}else{elbow[0]=-.28;elbow[1]=1.12+bob;elbow[2]=.14;wrist[0]=.10;wrist[1]=1.20+bob;wrist[2]=.24}}
       else if(act==='calm'){elbow[0]=side*.34;elbow[1]=1.16+bob;elbow[2]=.06;wrist[0]=side*.30;wrist[1]=.98+bob;wrist[2]=.16}}
    }
    if(!a.kb11Cine&&a===actors[active]&&side===1&&!footballer&&!riding){
      const LL=lampLevel();a.grip=null;
      if(LL>.02){elbow[1]=lerp(elbow[1],1.16+bob,LL);elbow[2]=lerp(elbow[2],.15,LL);wrist[0]=lerp(wrist[0],.31,LL);wrist[1]=lerp(wrist[1],(aim||aimHeld?1.39:1.17)+bob,LL);wrist[2]=lerp(wrist[2],.39,LL);
      a.grip=wrist.slice();}}
    kb11Line(b,upper,[side*.344,1.300+bob,swingZ*.27],.123,shirt);
    kb11Line(b,[side*.344,1.300+bob,swingZ*.27],elbow,.077,sk);
    kb11Line(b,elbow,wrist,.063,sk);
    if(role.style==='maroonPolo'){kb11Line(b,[side*.341,1.318+bob,swingZ*.27],[side*.344,1.3+bob,swingZ*.27],.128,'#efe3df');if(side===1)kb11Line(b,[wrist[0],wrist[1]+.048,wrist[2]],[wrist[0],wrist[1]+.016,wrist[2]],.07,'#17181b')}
    b.sphere(wrist[0],wrist[1],wrist[2],.070,.085,.064,sk);
    if(ultra){for(let j=0;j<3;j++)kb11Line(b,[wrist[0]+(j-1)*.025,wrist[1]-.032,wrist[2]+.027],[wrist[0]+(j-1)*.027,wrist[1]-.090,wrist[2]+.059],.011,sk)}
  }
  const h=kb11Head(b,role,pose,near,move);
  transformMesh(b,h,0,headY+bob,0,pose.head*.65,0,-pose.pitch*.18);
  // No changes to gameplay collision or physics; this is a render-only transformation.
  const Y=(interior?0:height(a.x,a.z))+(a.jump||0);castActorShadow(m,a,Y-(a.jump||0));
  const stanceDrop=!a.kb11Cine&&i===active&&!riding?motion.stance:0;
  const bend=y=>.29*stanceDrop*clamp((y-.56)/.64,0,1);
  if(stanceDrop>.001)for(let j=1;j<b.out.length;j+=7)b.out[j]-=bend(b.out[j]);
  const lean=riding?ride.lean:pose.lean,tilt=riding?ride.wheel*.22:-(pose.run*.09)-(pose.fwd||0)-stanceDrop*.08,scale=role.height||1;
  transformMesh(m,b.out,a.x,Y,a.z,a.yaw||0,lean,tilt,scale);
  if(!a.kb11Cine&&a===actors[active]&&a.grip){const g=a.grip.slice();g[1]-=bend(g[1]);motion.hand=gripWorld(g,a,Y,lean,tilt,scale);}

}
window.KB_HERO_PREVIEW_11=Object.freeze(KB_HERO_11.map(({name,style,hairStyle})=>({name,style,hairStyle})));

/* Hero-only story portrait, same costume as the 3D rig. Does not touch 2D game portraits. */
function kb11Portrait(canvas,index,large=false){
  const c=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!c)return;
  const photo=KB11_IMAGES[index];if(photo&&photo.complete&&photo.naturalWidth>0){
    c.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height); c.drawImage(photo,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);return;
  }
  const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height,r=KB_HERO_11[index%3],a=actors[index],s=Math.min(W/170,H/255);
  c.clearRect(0,0,W,H);const bg=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,H);bg.addColorStop(0,index===0?'#34433f':index===1?'#313746':'#4d3439');bg.addColorStop(1,'#15191d');c.fillStyle=bg;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  c.save();c.translate(W/2,H-5*s);c.scale(s,s);
  const fill=(col)=>{c.fillStyle=col;c.fill()};
  const rect=(x,y,w,h,color,rad=0)=>{c.fillStyle=color;c.beginPath();c.roundRect(x,y,w,h,rad);c.fill()};
  const shape=(pts,col)=>{c.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(...p):c.moveTo(...p));c.closePath();fill(col)};
  c.fillStyle='#090d13aa';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-1,42,7,0,0,TAU);c.fill();
  const sw=Math.sin((a.phase||0))*clamp(a.move/5,0,1)*6;
  // Shoes, legs, navy shorts on Lazar, full black pants for Andrej/Petar.
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    if(index===1){shape([[side*2,-115],[side*28,-116],[side*26,-79],[side*3,-79]],r.pants);rect(side*17-10,-80,19,52,r.skin,5);rect(side*17-10,-30,19,11,'#eaeaec',4)}
    else shape([[side*2,-116],[side*29,-116],[side*25+sw*side,-20],[side*4+sw*side,-20]],r.pants);
    if(index===0){rect(side*28+(side===-1?-2:-2),-96,2,65,'#e2e2e4',1)}
    if(index===2)rect(side*17-10,-97,24,17,'#262930',3);
    rect(side*15-16+sw*side,-23,31,17,r.shoe,6);rect(side*15-17+sw*side,-8,34,3,r.sole,2);
  }

function planWorld(clientX,clientY){const box=scene.getBoundingClientRect(),v=r6.view;if(!v)return null;const px=clientX-box.left,py=clientY-box.top;return {x:v.x+(px-v.W/2)/v.s,z:v.z+(py-v.H*.53)/(v.s*.78)};}
function pathWorld(c,rings,roof=0){c.beginPath();for(const ring of rings){for(let i=0;i<ring.length;i++){const a=planProject(ring[i][0],ring[i][1],roof);i?c.lineTo(...a):c.moveTo(...a);}c.closePath();}}
function drawPlanHuman(c,a,i,player=false){const p=planProject(a.x,a.z),s=r6.view.s,ph=a.phase||0,r=a.team!==undefined?{...CREW_ROLES[i%3],coat:a.team===0?'#4a9b79':'#ba6859'}:window.KBRewardsA2.role(CREW_ROLES[i%3],i%3),motion=clamp((a.move||0)/5,0,1),swing=Math.sin(ph)*s*.3*motion,bodyYaw=a.yaw||0,look=i===active?yaw:bodyYaw,breath=Math.sin(time*2.2+i)*s*.018;c.save();c.translate(...p);c.fillStyle='#07151b77';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(s*.12,s*.08,s*.65,s*.22,bodyYaw*.15,0,TAU);c.fill();for(const side of [-1,1]){c.strokeStyle=r.pants;c.lineWidth=s*.22;c.lineCap='round';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(side*s*.17,-s*.65);c.lineTo(side*s*.19,-s*.08+side*swing);c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#bfc9bd';c.fillRect(side*s*.18-s*.12,-s*.07+side*swing,s*.25,s*.08);}if(i===2){c.fillStyle='#586b50';c.beginPath();c.roundRect(-s*.47,-s*1.6,s*.94,s*.9,s*.15);c.fill();}c.fillStyle=r.coat;c.beginPath();c.roundRect(-s*.36,-s*1.55+breath,s*.72,s*.98,s*.22);c.fill();c.strokeStyle=r.trim;c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,s*.045);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-s*1.5);c.lineTo(0,-s*.66);c.stroke();for(const side of [-1,1]){const hx=side*s*.49+Math.sin(bodyYaw)*s*.07,hy=-s*.85+breath+side*swing*.35;c.strokeStyle=r.coat;c.lineWidth=s*.19;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(side*s*.31,-s*1.38);c.lineTo(hx,hy);c.stroke();c.fillStyle=r.skin;c.beginPath();c.arc(hx,hy,s*.105,0,TAU);c.fill();if(side===1){c.save();c.translate(hx,hy);c.rotate(-look);c.fillStyle=i===1?'#65d4da':i===2?'#e9b768':'#f1ddaa';c.fillRect(-s*.09,-s*.24,s*.18,s*.26);c.restore();}}c.fillStyle=r.skin;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(Math.sin(look-bodyYaw)*s*.06,-s*1.83+breath,s*.235,s*.27,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle=r.hair;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-s*1.99+breath,s*.25,s*.17,0,Math.PI,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#16272b';for(const side of [-1,1])c.fillRect(side*s*.08+Math.sin(look)*s*.05-s*.025,-s*1.85+breath,s*.045,s*.04);if(player){c.strokeStyle=r.accent;c.lineWidth=1.3;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,s*.1,s*.60,s*.25,0,0,TAU);c.stroke();}c.restore();}
function drawPlanDog(c,d){const [x,y]=planProject(d.x,d.z),s=r6.view.s,a=d.yaw||0;c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(-a);c.fillStyle=d.state==='chase'?'#75604e':'#99815c';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-s*.5,s*.28,s*.59,0,0,TAU);c.fill();for(const sign of [-1,1]){c.strokeStyle='#4e5142';c.lineWidth=s*.09;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(sign*s*.2,-s*.7);c.lineTo(sign*s*.35+Math.sin(d.phase||0)*s*.13,-s*.15);c.stroke();}c.fillStyle='#a99776';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-s*1.05,s*.23,s*.27,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle=d.state==='chase'?'#ef9b80':'#1b2c2d';c.fillRect(-s*.13,-s*1.13,s*.07,s*.055);c.fillRect(s*.065,-s*1.13,s*.07,s*.055);c.restore();}
function drawPlanWorld(c,p){const v=r6.view,s=v.s,radius=Math.hypot(v.W/s,v.H/s)*.6+25;if(!r6.terrain||r6.terrainSeason!==season)prepareTerrain();const size=HALF*2*s,origin=planProject(-HALF,-HALF);c.drawImage(r6.terrain,origin[0],origin[1],size,size*.78);const roadSet=new Set();for(let x=Math.floor((v.x-radius)/64);x<=Math.floor((v.x+radius)/64);x++)for(let z=Math.floor((v.z-radius)/64);z<=Math.floor((v.z+radius)/64);z++)for(const seg of roadGrid.get(x+','+z)||[])roadSet.add(seg);for(const border of [true,false])for(const seg of roadSet){const a=planProject(...seg.a),b=planProject(...seg.b),dirt=/path|track|foot/.test(seg.road.type);c.strokeStyle=border?(dirt?'#9a9477':'#737d7c'):(dirt?'#9c916c':'#394a50');c.lineWidth=(seg.road.width+(border?.55:0))*s;c.lineCap='round';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...a);c.lineTo(...b);c.stroke();}
 drawPlanPitch(c);if(time-r6.nearAt>.24||hyp(v.x-(r6.nearX??1e9),v.z-(r6.nearZ??1e9))>5||r6.nearRadius!==radius){r6.near=nearbyColliders(v.x,v.z,radius);r6.nearAt=time;r6.nearX=v.x;r6.nearZ=v.z;r6.nearRadius=radius;}const drawables=[];for(const item of r6.near){if(item.kind==='building'){const h=item.house;if(h)drawables.push({z:h.bound[3],house:h});}else if(item.kind==='tree')drawables.push({z:item.z,tree:item});else if(!['r6-fence','r6-gate','pole'].includes(item.kind))drawables.push({z:item.bound[3],solid:item});}
 for(const a of actors)if(crewVisible(actors.indexOf(a))&&distance(a,p)<radius)drawables.push({z:a.z,actor:a});for(const d of dogs)if(distance(d,p)<radius)drawables.push({z:d.z,dog:d});if(story.on)drawables.push({z:reks.z,dog:reks});
 if(football)for(const a of football.players)drawables.push({z:a.z,footballer:a});drawables.sort((a,b)=>a.z-b.z);
 for(const d of drawables){if(d.house){const h=d.house,H=clamp(h.height||h.floors*2.85,3,12),roof=Math.min(2.7,H*.25);for(let k=1;k<h.poly.length;k++){const a=planProject(...h.poly[k-1]),b=planProject(...h.poly[k]),A=planProject(...h.poly[k-1],roof),B=planProject(...h.poly[k],roof);c.fillStyle='#868a76';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...a);c.lineTo(...b);c.lineTo(...B);c.lineTo(...A);c.fill();}pathWorld(c,h.rings,roof);c.fillStyle=h.hero==='secret'?'#b6788e':'#a16c57';c.fill('evenodd');c.strokeStyle='#533e3d';c.lineWidth=1;c.stroke();const bb=h.bound,mid=planProject(h.c[0],h.c[1],roof+.12);c.strokeStyle='#dfab7870';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(mid[0]-(bb[2]-bb[0])*s*.35,mid[1]);c.lineTo(mid[0]+(bb[2]-bb[0])*s*.35,mid[1]);c.stroke();}else if(d.tree){const a=d.tree,P=planProject(a.x,a.z),R=s*(a.tree?.park?2.1:1.7);c.fillStyle='#162e2770';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(P[0]+s*.3,P[1]+s*.3,R*1.15,R*.5,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#7c7254';c.lineWidth=s*.25;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...P);c.lineTo(P[0],P[1]-s*2.5);c.stroke();c.fillStyle=season===3?'#99b3a0':season===2?'#92764e':'#356749';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(P[0],P[1]-s*2.5,R,R*.78,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle=season===2?'#b2915d66':'#77a16c44';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(P[0]-R*.25,P[1]-s*2.8,R*.7,R*.5,0,0,TAU);c.fill();}else if(d.solid)drawPlanSolid(c,d.solid);else if(d.actor)drawPlanHuman(c,d.actor,actors.indexOf(d.actor),d.actor===p);else if(d.footballer)drawPlanHuman(c,d.footballer,d.footballer.team===0?0:1,d.footballer===p);else drawPlanDog(c,d.dog);}
 for(const f of r6.fences){if(hyp(f.a[0]-v.x,f.a[1]-v.z)>radius)continue;const a=planProject(...f.a),b=planProject(...f.b),A=planProject(...f.a,1.5),B=planProject(...f.b,1.5);c.fillStyle='#8a7557';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...a);c.lineTo(...b);c.lineTo(...B);c.lineTo(...A);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#c0a170';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...A);c.lineTo(...B);c.stroke();}
 for(const [a,b]of wires){if(hyp((a.x+b.x)/2-v.x,(a.z+b.z)/2-v.z)>radius+35)continue;c.strokeStyle='#253938';c.lineWidth=.8;for(const offset of [-.6,.6]){c.beginPath();for(let k=0;k<=8;k++){const t=k/8,q=planProject(lerp(a.x,b.x,t)+offset,lerp(a.z,b.z,t),4.7-Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*.55);k?c.lineTo(...q):c.moveTo(...q);}c.stroke();}}for(const pole of poles)if(distance(p,pole)<radius){const a=planProject(pole.x,pole.z),b=planProject(pole.x,pole.z,4.5);c.strokeStyle='#8e9a90';c.lineWidth=s*.12;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...a);c.lineTo(...b);c.stroke();if(dusk>.4){c.fillStyle='#f8d69c';c.beginPath();c.arc(b[0],b[1],2,0,TAU);c.fill();}}
 c.strokeStyle='#c2d5b880';c.lineWidth=1;for(const path of PARK.paths){c.beginPath();path.forEach((a,i)=>i?c.lineTo(...planProject(...a)):c.moveTo(...planProject(...a)));c.stroke();}
 if(route.length){c.strokeStyle='#d9c28488';c.lineWidth=1.8;c.setLineDash([3,6]);c.beginPath();route.forEach((a,i)=>i?c.lineTo(...planProject(...a)):c.moveTo(...planProject(...a)));c.stroke();c.setLineDash([]);}
 const target=story.on?task():waypoint;if(target){const a=planProject(target.x,target.z);c.strokeStyle='#ffe3ac';c.lineWidth=1.7;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(...a,s*.8,s*.5,0,0,TAU);c.stroke();}
 if(football){const b=football.ball,a=planProject(b.x,b.z,b.y-footballY());c.fillStyle='#efebd6';c.beginPath();c.arc(...a,s*.24,0,TAU);c.fill();}drawPlanStory(c,p);drawPlanExtras(c,p);
}
function drawPlanLight(c){if(football)return;const p=actors[active],v=r6.view,mask=r6.maskCtx,W=v.W,H=v.H;if(r6.mask.width!==r6.canvas.width||r6.mask.height!==r6.canvas.height){r6.mask.width=r6.canvas.width;r6.mask.height=r6.canvas.height;}mask.setTransform(v.dpr,0,0,v.dpr,0,0);mask.clearRect(0,0,W,H);mask.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';mask.fillStyle='rgba(3,12,21,'+(dusk*.78)+')';mask.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const A=planProject(p.x,p.z);if(lampEffective()){mask.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';const precise=!document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco')&&r6.avg<16,key=r6.field.serial+':'+Math.round(yaw*400)+':'+active+':'+precise;if(r6.fanKey!==key){r6.fanKey=key;r6.coneFan=r6.field.polygon(Math.PI/2-yaw,active===0?.34:active===2?.60:.44,precise);}const fan=r6.coneFan;mask.save();KBLight2D.path(mask,fan,q=>planProject(q.x,q.y));mask.clip();const grad=mask.createRadialGradient(...A,0,...A,48*v.s);grad.addColorStop(0,'#fffffffa');grad.addColorStop(.42,'#ffffffb0');grad.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');mask.fillStyle=grad;mask.fillRect(0,0,W,H);mask.restore();if(r6.fullFanSerial!==r6.field.serial){r6.fullFanSerial=r6.field.serial;r6.fullFan=r6.field.polygon(0,Math.PI,false);}const ambient=r6.fullFan;mask.save();KBLight2D.path(mask,ambient,q=>planProject(q.x,q.y));mask.clip();const g=mask.createRadialGradient(...A,0,...A,4*v.s);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffffb0');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');mask.fillStyle=g;mask.fillRect(A[0]-4*v.s,A[1]-4*v.s,8*v.s,8*v.s);mask.restore();}
 if(dusk>.4){mask.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';for(const pole of poles){if(distance(p,pole)>65)continue;const q=planProject(pole.x,pole.z),g=mask.createRadialGradient(...q,0,...q,8*v.s);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff60');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');mask.fillStyle=g;mask.beginPath();mask.ellipse(q[0],q[1],8*v.s,6.24*v.s,0,0,TAU);mask.fill();}}if(cine)for(const f of cine.flares.filter(f=>f.until>time).slice(-3)){const a=planProject(f.x,f.z),g=mask.createRadialGradient(...a,0,...a,13*v.s);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffffda');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');mask.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';mask.fillStyle=g;mask.beginPath();mask.arc(...a,13*v.s,0,TAU);mask.fill();}mask.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';c.drawImage(r6.mask,0,0,W,H);}
function renderAtmosphere(c,W,H,s=1){const eco=document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco'),p=actors[active],near=dogs.reduce((n,d)=>Math.min(n,distance(p,d)),cine?.shadow?distance(p,cine.shadow):1e5),danger=clamp(1-near/15,0,1),pulse=reduced?.65:.65+.35*Math.sin(time*6);c.save();if(r6.fog){c.globalCompositeOperation='screen';for(let layer=0;layer<(eco?2:4);layer++){const w=W*(.75+layer*.17),h=H*(.30+layer*.04),x=((time*(5+layer*3)-p.x*(layer+1)*.7)%(w+W)+w+W)%(w+W)-w,y=H*(.40+layer*.14)+Math.sin(time*.13+layer)*H*.04;c.globalAlpha=(.12+dusk*.18+rain*.15)/(1+layer*.15);c.drawImage(r6.fog,x,y,w,h);c.drawImage(r6.fog,x+w,y,w,h);}c.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';c.globalAlpha=1;}
 if(rain>.12||season===2){const n=eco?26:r6.avg>16?45:86;c.strokeStyle='#b8d0df70';c.lineWidth=.8;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=r6.particles[i],x=((a.x*W-time*(season===2?15:50)*a.s)%W+W)%W,y=((a.y*H+time*(season===2?27:320)*a.s)%H+H)%H;if(season===2){c.fillStyle=i%2?'#c1a25b99':'#ac7d4b99';c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(time+a.phase);c.fillRect(-3,-1.4,6,2.8);c.restore();}else{c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(x-4,y+12*a.s);c.stroke();}}}
 const vin=c.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H*.5,H*.17,W*.5,H*.5,H*.80);vin.addColorStop(0,'#00000000');vin.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+(danger>0?'58,10,19':'2,9,16')+','+(.35+danger*pulse*.4)+')');c.fillStyle=vin;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 {const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(20,60,84,'+(.12+dusk*.16)+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,140,64,'+(.09*(1-dusk))+')');c.globalCompositeOperation='soft-light';c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 if(!eco){const pt=kbGrain(c),rx=Math.random()*128|0,ry=Math.random()*128|0;c.save();c.translate(rx,ry);c.globalCompositeOperation='overlay';c.globalAlpha=.07+dusk*.04;c.fillStyle=pt;c.fillRect(-rx,-ry,W,H);c.restore()}
 c.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';c.globalAlpha=1}
 c.restore();scene.dataset.threat=String(Math.round(danger*100));}
function renderPlan(dt,ts){initPlan();if(r6.post)r6.post.style.display='none';r6.canvas.style.display='block';const start=performance.now(),W=scene.clientWidth,H=scene.clientHeight,eco=document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco'),dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,eco?1:1.5)*r6.scale;if(r6.canvas.width!==Math.round(W*dpr)||r6.canvas.height!==Math.round(H*dpr)){r6.canvas.width=Math.round(W*dpr);r6.canvas.height=Math.round(H*dpr);}const p=football?football.players[football.selected]:actors[active],flight=transition?Math.sin(clamp(transition.t/transition.duration,0,1)*Math.PI):0,s=clamp(Math.min(W/88,H/51),6.5,18)*(1-flight*.65);r6.view={x:transition?cam.eye[0]:p.x,z:transition?cam.eye[2]:p.z,s,W,H,dpr};const c=r6.ctx;c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);c.fillStyle='#3b5847';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);updateRayLight();drawPlanWorld(c,p);window.KBStoryExtensions?.paintPlan(c,s);drawPlanLight(c);renderAtmosphere(c,W,H,s);r6.cost=performance.now()-start;r6.avg=lerp(r6.avg,r6.cost,.04);r6.frames++;if(ts-r6.since>1000){r6.fps=Math.round(r6.frames*1000/(ts-r6.since));r6.frames=0;r6.since=ts;}scene.dataset.renderer='canvas-2.5d';scene.dataset.fps=String(r6.fps);scene.dataset.frameMs=r6.avg.toFixed(2);scene.dataset.rays=String(r6.field.samples);}

function groundMaterial(x,z){if(pointInside(x,z,PARK.poly))return 'grass';if(distance({x,z},LOC[4])<80)return 'mud';const n=nearestRoad(x,z);if(n.road&&n.d<n.road.width*.65){if(/Njegoševa|Gostivarska/.test(n.road.name))return 'asphalt';if(/path|foot|track|steps/.test(n.road.type)||distance({x,z},LOC[0])<60)return rain>.5?'mud':'gravel';return 'asphalt';}return inWood(x,z)?rain>.3?'mud':'grass':inGreen(x,z)?'grass':'gravel';}
function sourcePan(at,output=audio?.destination){if(!audio)return null;let pan;if(audio.createPanner){pan=audio.createPanner();pan.panningModel='HRTF';pan.distanceModel='inverse';pan.refDistance=3;pan.maxDistance=100;pan.rolloffFactor=.9;const y=height(at.x,at.z)+.8;if(pan.positionX){pan.positionX.value=at.x;pan.positionY.value=y;pan.positionZ.value=at.z;}else pan.setPosition(at.x,y,at.z);}else if(audio.createStereoPanner){pan=audio.createStereoPanner();pan.pan.value=clamp(Math.sin(Math.atan2(at.x-actors[active].x,at.z-actors[active].z)-yaw),-1,1);}else return output;pan.connect(output);return pan;}
function makeNoise(){if(sound6.noise||!audio)return;const n=Math.floor(audio.sampleRate*.5),b=audio.createBuffer(1,n,audio.sampleRate),a=b.getChannelData(0),r=randSeed(1761);let brown=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){brown=(brown+(r()*2-1)*.09)/1.03;a[i]=brown*.6+(r()*2-1)*.2;}sound6.noise=b;}
function surfaceStep(){if(!audio||audio.state!=='running')return;makeNoise();const p=actors[active],kind=groundMaterial(p.x,p.z),profiles={asphalt:[850,.055,.13,115],gravel:[2300,.105,.17,160],grass:[430,.09,.10,75],mud:[210,.14,.15,58]},[freq,length,volume,tone]=profiles[kind],t=audio.currentTime,src=audio.createBufferSource(),filter=audio.createBiquadFilter(),gain=audio.createGain();src.buffer=sound6.noise;src.playbackRate.value=kind==='mud'?.7:kind==='gravel'?1.35:1;filter.type=kind==='gravel'?'highpass':'lowpass';filter.frequency.value=freq;gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume*(p.move>5?1.15:.8),t+.008);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+length);src.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(audio.destination);src.start(t,(p.phase%1)*.15);src.stop(t+length+.02);src.onended=()=>{src.disconnect();filter.disconnect();gain.disconnect();};const o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(tone,t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(tone*.45,t+length);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.018,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+length);o.connect(g);g.connect(audio.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+length+.01);o.onended=()=>{o.disconnect();g.disconnect();};scene.dataset.surface=kind;}
function spatialBark(volume=1,at=actors[active]){if(!audio||audio.state!=='running')return;makeNoise();const pan=sourcePan(at),t=audio.currentTime,src=audio.createBufferSource(),filter=audio.createBiquadFilter(),gain=audio.createGain();src.buffer=sound6.noise;src.playbackRate.value=.75;filter.type='bandpass';filter.frequency.value=520;filter.Q.value=1.5;const blocked=!lineClear(actors[active],at,.08),v=volume*(blocked?.045:.12);gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.001,v),t+.018);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+.10);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.002,v*.7),t+.145);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.29);src.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(pan);src.start(t);src.stop(t+.32);src.onended=()=>{src.disconnect();filter.disconnect();gain.disconnect();if(pan!==audio.destination)pan.disconnect();};}

function spatialListener(){if(!audio||time<sound6.nextListener)return;sound6.nextListener=time+.08;const a=actors[active],L=audio.listener,Y=height(a.x,a.z)+1.6,fx=Math.sin(yaw),fz=Math.cos(yaw),t=audio.currentTime;if(L.positionX){L.positionX.setValueAtTime(a.x,t);L.positionY.setValueAtTime(Y,t);L.positionZ.setValueAtTime(a.z,t);L.forwardX.setValueAtTime(fx,t);L.forwardY.setValueAtTime(0,t);L.forwardZ.setValueAtTime(fz,t);L.upX.setValueAtTime(0,t);L.upY.setValueAtTime(1,t);L.upZ.setValueAtTime(0,t);}else{L.setPosition?.(a.x,Y,a.z);L.setOrientation?.(fx,0,fz,0,1,0);}prepareStationAudio();if(sound6.filter){const occluded=!lineClear(a,{x:LOC[8].x,z:LOC[8].z+4},.1);sound6.filter.frequency.setTargetAtTime(occluded?450:1800,audio.currentTime,.2);}}

function accordionNote(dist){if(part2){part2.audio.accordion(dist);return;}if(!audio||audio.state!=='running')return;const melody=[293.66,349.23,440,392,349.23,329.63,293.66,261.63],note=melody[Math.floor(time/.36)%melody.length],v=clamp(1-dist/65,0,.8)*.013;try{for(const [harm,gain]of [[1,1],[2,.28],[3,.13]]){const o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain(),pan=audio.createStereoPanner?.();o.type='sawtooth';o.frequency.value=note*harm;const t=audio.currentTime;g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*gain,t+.08);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.34);o.connect(g);if(pan){pan.pan.value=clamp(Math.sin(Math.atan2(LOC[3].x-actors[active].x,LOC[3].z-actors[active].z)-yaw),-1,1);g.connect(pan);pan.connect(audio.destination);}else g.connect(audio.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.36);}}catch(_){}}
const carBodies=new Map(),parkedCells=new Map();let parkedCars=[];
function parkedCell(x,z){return (Math.floor(x/12)+128)*256+Math.floor(z/12)+128;}
function registerParkedCar(c){
 c.cs=Math.cos(c.yaw);c.sn=Math.sin(c.yaw);
 for(const dx of [-12,0,12])for(const dz of [-12,0,12]){
   const k=parkedCell(c.x+dx,c.z+dz);let list=parkedCells.get(k);if(!list){list=[];parkedCells.set(k,list);}list.push(c);
 }
}
function parkedCarCollision(x,z,r){
 if(!r2||!parkedCars.length)return false;
 const nearby=r>5?parkedCars:parkedCells.get(parkedCell(x,z));if(!nearby)return false;
 for(const c of nearby){const dx=x-c.x,dz=z-c.z;
   const side=Math.max(0,Math.abs(dx*c.cs-dz*c.sn)-.87),front=Math.max(0,Math.abs(dx*c.sn+dz*c.cs)-2.0);
   if(side*side+front*front<=r*r)return true;}
 return false;
}
function carShell(paint,patrol){
  const key=paint+(patrol?'p':'');if(carBodies.has(key))return carBodies.get(key);
  const b=Mesh(),rings=[[-2.03,.61,.39,.62],[-1.79,.86,.32,.84],[-1.1,.90,.31,.92],[.85,.89,.32,.90],[1.66,.85,.34,.77],[2.02,.67,.42,.62]];
  const cross=([z,w,low,top])=>[[-w*.86,low,z],[-w,low+.12,z],[-w,top-.12,z],[-w*.84,top,z],[w*.84,top,z],[w,top-.12,z],[w,low+.12,z],[w*.86,low,z]];
  let front=cross(rings[0]);for(const part of rings.slice(1)){const next=cross(part);for(let k=0;k<8;k++)b.quad(front[k],next[k],next[(k+1)%8],front[(k+1)%8],k===7?'#2d3030':paint);front=next;}
  for(const ix of [0,rings.length-1]){const poly=cross(rings[ix]);for(let k=1;k<7;k++)b.tri(poly[0],poly[k],poly[k+1],paint);}
  const base=[[-.80,.84,-1.40],[-.80,.84,1.03],[.80,.84,1.03],[.80,.84,-1.40]],roof=[[-.61,1.44,-.86],[-.61,1.45,.29],[.61,1.45,.29],[.61,1.44,-.86]];
  b.quad(...roof,paint);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const j=(i+1)%4;b.quad(base[i],base[j],roof[j],roof[i],'#526a70',10);
    roundBone(b,base[i],roof[i],.043,paint,.038,0,5);roundBone(b,roof[i],roof[j],.039,paint,.039,0,5);}
  for(const t of [-1,1]){
    roundBone(b,[t*.80,.86,-.40],[t*.61,1.43,-.42],.040,'#252c2e',.037,0,5);
    b.box(t*.82,.77,.18,.04,.045,.17,'#929995');b.sphere(t*.92,1.00,.60,.14,.074,.11,paint);
    b.box(t*.57,.61,2.019,.35,.13,.05,patrol?'#f5e6c6':'#bbcdce',patrol?11:10);
    b.box(t*.58,.62,-2.035,.31,.11,.055,'#bc3235',patrol?11:0);
  }
  for(const z of [-2.03,2.025]){b.box(0,.42,z,1.38,.12,.11,'#414748');b.box(0,.56,z*1.018,.42,.1,.015,'#c0c1ae');}
  for(let j=0;j<5;j++)b.box(-.24+j*.12,.68,2.025,.070,.096,.018,'#303637');
  if(patrol){b.box(0,1.49,-.29,1.0,.08,.23,'#323b40');}
  carBodies.set(key,b.out);return b.out;
}
function carWheel(b,x,z,phase){
 const side=Math.sign(x),y=.34;
 roundBone(b,[x-.105,y,z],[x+.105,y,z],.315,'#232724',.315,0,12);
 const xx=x+side*.112;
 roundBone(b,[xx,y,z],[xx+side*.012,y,z],.186,'#79817e',.186,0,12);
 for(let j=0;j<5;j++){const a=phase+j*TAU/5;b.tri([xx+side*.016,y,z],[xx+side*.016,y+.154*Math.cos(a),z+.154*Math.sin(a)],[xx+side*.016,y+.142*Math.cos(a+.44),z+.142*Math.sin(a+.44)],'#333a3d');}
}
function patrolCarModel(m,car,staticOnly=false){
 const isPatrol=car.kind!=='car'&&!car.parked,paint=car.paint||(isPatrol?'#304354':'#627477'),b=Mesh();

function buildParkedCars(m){
 parkedCars=[];parkedCells.clear();for(let i=0;i<roadSegments.length&&parkedCars.length<24;i++){const e=roadSegments[i],w=e.road.width,dx=e.b[0]-e.a[0],dz=e.b[1]-e.a[1],l=hyp(dx,dz);
 if(w<4.6||l<9||r2Hash('parking'+i,7)>.23)continue;
 const side=i%2?1:-1,off=side*(w/2+2.65),x=(e.a[0]+e.b[0])/2+dz/l*off,z=(e.a[1]+e.b[1])/2-dx/l*off;
 if(Math.abs(x)>HALF-6||Math.abs(z)>HALF-6||pointInside(x,z,PARK.poly)||Math.abs(x-FIELD.x)<FIELD.w/2+9&&Math.abs(z-FIELD.z)<FIELD.d/2+9||LOC.some(o=>hyp(o.x-x,o.z-z)<10)||parkedCars.some(c=>hyp(c.x-x,c.z-z)<23))continue;
 const car={x,z,yaw:Math.atan2(dx,dz)+(side>0?0:Math.PI),parked:true,paint:['#6c746a','#884f48','#b9b7ab','#4a6476'][i%4]};
 const entry=houses.some(h=>h.door&&hyp(h.door.x-x,h.door.z-z)<5);if(entry)continue;
 if([-2.2,0,2.2].some(v=>[-1,0,1].some(u=>{const xx=x+u*dz/l+v*dx/l,zz=z-u*dx/l+v*dz/l,r=nearestRoad(xx,zz);return collide(xx,zz,.3)||r.d<(r.road?.width||4)*.5+1.0;})))continue;
 parkedCars.push(car);registerParkedCar(car);patrolCarModel(m,car,true);}
}

function paintEvidence(m,t){
 const x=t.x,z=t.z,y=height(x,z)+.12;
 if(['message','bench','playback','whistle'].includes(t.type)){
   m.quad([x-.18,y,z-.13],[x+.17,y+.01,z-.12],[x+.15,y+.018,z+.13],[x-.18,y,z+.14],'#d4c6a1');
   for(let j=0;j<3;j++)m.rod([x-.13,y+.018,z-.06+j*.042],[x+.095-j*.025,y+.022,z-.06+j*.042],.006,'#5a5550');
 }else if(['morse','trace','wire','lamp'].includes(t.type)){
   const pp=t.pole||(t.type==='wire'?missionScene.poles[2].pole:t),Y=height(pp.x,pp.z);

   if(t.type==='wire'&&!cine.flags.power){const intensity=sparkStrength(time);

   const f=.04*Math.sin(time*9);m.tri([x-.065,y+.29,z],[x+.083,y+.29,z],[x+f,y+.61,z+.034],'#f5b25d',11);}
}

  const isPlaying = () => !!(st.audio && !st.audio.paused && !st.audio.ended);
  function home() {
    clearInterval(st.timer); st.vf = null; st.app = '';
    screen.className = 'kp-screen';
    screen.innerHTML = '<div class="kp-wg"><b class="kp-wt">--:--</b><span class="kp-wd"></span></div><div class="kp-grid"></div>';

    });
    if (st.song >= 0 && st.audio) {
      const m = document.createElement('div'); m.className = 'kp-mini';
      m.innerHTML = '<span>♪</span><b>' + esc(SG().title(st.song)) + '</b><button type="button" data-a="pp">' + (isPlaying() ? '⏸' : '▶') + '</button><button type="button" data-a="st">⏹</button><canvas class="kp-vz mini"></canvas>' + volHtml();
      m.querySelector('[data-a=pp]').onclick = () => { togglePlay(); home(); };
      m.querySelector('[data-a=st]').onclick = () => { stopMusic(); home(); }; wireVol(m);
      screen.appendChild(m);
    }
    updateBadge(); vzKick();
  }
  function shell(title, build) {

    screen.innerHTML = ''; screen.className = 'kp-screen app'; screen.appendChild(a);

  }
  function openApp(id) {
    st.app = id;
    ({tube, msg, task, gps, lamp, insta, calc, clock, cam, gal}[id] || home)();
    if (id !== 'lamp') updateBadge();
  }

  /* --- PeraTube --- */
  function stopMusic() { if (st.audio) { try { st.audio.pause(); } catch (_) {} } spatialDetach(); st.audio = null; st.song = -1; }

  /* ---------- 3D ZVUK: pesma svira iz telefona koji je u svetu ----------
     Telefon ostaje kod lika koji je pustio pesmu. Slušalac je uvek lik kojim trenutno igraš:
     kad se prebaciš na drugog lika (npr. Lazara) koji je dalje, pesma se čuje tiše, prigušenije
     i sa one strane sa koje telefon stvarno svira. Zid/kuća između dodatno prigušuje.
     Jačinu menjaš klizačem u telefonu ili tasterima  -  i  +  . */
  function loadVol() { try { const v = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('kb_phone_vol')); if (isFinite(v)) return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v)); } catch (_) {} return .8; }
  function saveVol() { try { localStorage.setItem('kb_phone_vol', String(st.vol)); } catch (_) {} }
  const sp = {ctx: null, n: null, el: null, raf: 0, d: 0, g: 1, blocked: false, mine: true, chk: 0, ui: 0, rs: 0, act: null};
  const poss = n => n === 'Pera' ? 'Perin' : n + 'ev';
  const nameOf = i => { const h = H(), a = h && h.actors && h.actors[i]; return a && a.n ? a.n : 'Tuđi'; };
  /* 1 u ruci · ~.55 na 5 m · ~.33 na 10 m · ~.17 na 20 m · posle 40 m utihne do nule na 70 m */
  function distGain(d) {
    const base = (1 + Math.pow(1 / 6, 1.3)) / (1 + Math.pow(Math.max(1, d) / 6, 1.3));
    const f = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (d - 40) / 30));
    return base * (1 - f * f * (3 - 2 * f));
  }
  function spText() {
    if (!st.audio) return '';
    if (sp.mine) return '📍 Pesma svira iz tvog telefona';
    return '📍 ' + poss(nameOf(st.owner)) + ' telefon svira ' + (sp.d > 45 ? 'negde daleko' : Math.round(sp.d) + ' m od tebe') + (sp.blocked ? ' · prigušeno' : '');
  }
  function volHtml() {
    const p = Math.round(st.vol * 100);
    return '<div class="kp-vol"><button type="button" class="vd" aria-label="Stišaj">🔈</button><input type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="' + p + '" aria-label="Jačina telefona"><button type="button" class="vu" aria-label="Pojačaj">🔊</button><span class="vp">' + p + '%</span></div><small class="kp-sp">' + esc(spText()) + '</small>';
  }
  function setVol(v, say) {
    st.vol = Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v)) * 100) / 100; saveVol();
    const p = Math.round(st.vol * 100);
    root.querySelectorAll('.kp-vol input').forEach(i => { if (+i.value !== p) i.value = p; });
    root.querySelectorAll('.kp-vol .vp').forEach(e => { e.textContent = p + '%'; });
    if (say) { const h = H(); if (h && h.tip) h.tip('🔊 Jačina telefona: ' + p + '%', 1.6); }
  }
  function wireVol(scope) {
    const r = scope.querySelector('.kp-vol input'); if (!r) return;
    r.oninput = () => setVol(r.value / 100);
    scope.querySelector('.kp-vol .vd').onclick = () => setVol(st.vol - .1);
    scope.querySelector('.kp-vol .vu').onclick = () => setVol(st.vol + .1);
  }
  function phCtx() {
    if (sp.ctx && sp.ctx.state !== 'closed') return sp.ctx;
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; if (!AC) return null;
    try { sp.ctx = new AC({latencyHint: 'playback'}); } catch (_) { try { sp.ctx = new AC(); } catch (__) { sp.ctx = null; } }
    return sp.ctx;
  }
  function spatialAttach(a) {
    spatialDetach();
    const h = H(); st.owner = h && h.active != null ? h.active : -1; sp.act = h ? h.active : null; sp.el = a;
    sp.mine = true; sp.d = .45; sp.g = 1; sp.blocked = false; sp.chk = 0;
    a.addEventListener('play', () => { if (!sp.raf && st.audio === a && sp.el === a) sp.raf = requestAnimationFrame(spatialTick); });
    try {
      const c = phCtx(); if (!c) throw 0; if (c.state === 'suspended') c.resume().catch(() => {});
      const src = c.createMediaElementSource(a);
      /* zvučnik telefona: bez basa, uska srednja oblast, blago izobličenje */
      const h1 = c.createBiquadFilter(); h1.type = 'highpass'; h1.frequency.value = 520; h1.Q.value = .9;
      const h2 = c.createBiquadFilter(); h2.type = 'highpass'; h2.frequency.value = 380; h2.Q.value = .7;
      const pk = c.createBiquadFilter(); pk.type = 'peaking'; pk.frequency.value = 1800; pk.Q.value = 1.2; pk.gain.value = 7;
      const lp = c.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = 'lowpass'; lp.frequency.value = 3300; lp.Q.value = 1;
      const ws = c.createWaveShaper(), cu = new Float32Array(1024); for (let k = 0; k < 1024; k++) cu[k] = Math.tanh((k / 512 - 1) * 2.2); ws.curve = cu; ws.oversample = '2x';
      const cm = c.createDynamicsCompressor(); cm.threshold.value = -26; cm.ratio.value = 8;
      const vg = c.createGain(); vg.gain.value = 0;
      const an = c.createAnalyser(); an.fftSize = 512; an.smoothingTimeConstant = .78; src.connect(an); /* za vizualizator */
      const pn = c.createPanner(); pn.panningModel = 'HRTF'; pn.distanceModel = 'inverse'; pn.refDistance = 1; pn.rolloffFactor = 0; /* jačinu po daljini računam sam */
      src.connect(h1); h1.connect(h2); h2.connect(pk); pk.connect(lp); lp.connect(ws); ws.connect(cm); cm.connect(vg); vg.connect(pn); pn.connect(c.destination);
      sp.n = {src, an, h1, h2, pk, lp, ws, cm, vg, pn};
      a.volume = 1;
    } catch (_) { sp.n = null; a.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, st.vol * st.vol)); }
    sp.raf = requestAnimationFrame(spatialTick);
    if (h && h.tip) h.tip('♪ Pesma svira iz tvog telefona · jačina: klizač u telefonu ili tasteri  -  /  +', 4);
  }
  function spatialDetach() {
    if (sp.raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(sp.raf); sp.raf = 0; }
    if (sp.n) { for (const k in sp.n) { try { sp.n[k].disconnect(); } catch (_) {} } sp.n = null; }
    sp.el = null; st.owner = -1;
  }
  function spatialTick(now) {
    sp.raf = 0;
    const a = st.audio; if (!a || a !== sp.el || !isPlaying()) return;
    sp.raf = requestAnimationFrame(spatialTick);
    const h = H(); if (!h || !h.live) return;
    const A = h.actors, me = A && A[h.active], ow = A && A[st.owner]; if (!me) return;
    const mine = !ow || st.owner === h.active, away = !mine && !!(h.interior || h.football);
    const fx = Math.sin(h.yaw), fz = Math.cos(h.yaw), ey = h.height(me.x, me.z) + 1.6;
    let d = .45, sx, sy, sz;
    if (mine) { sx = me.x + fx * .45; sy = ey - .45; sz = me.z + fz * .45; sp.blocked = false; }
    else {
      d = away ? 60 : Math.hypot(ow.x - me.x, ow.z - me.z);
      sx = ow.x; sy = h.height(ow.x, ow.z) + 1.1; sz = ow.z;
      if (away) sp.blocked = true;
      else if (now - sp.chk > 250) { sp.chk = now; try { sp.blocked = !h.lineClear(me, ow, .1); } catch (_) { sp.blocked = false; } }
    }
    const g = distGain(d) * (sp.blocked ? .4 : 1), amp = st.vol * st.vol;
    sp.d = d; sp.g = g;
    if (sp.mine !== mine || sp.act !== h.active) {
      const first = sp.act != null && sp.act !== h.active; sp.mine = mine; sp.act = h.active;
      if (first && h.tip) h.tip(mine ? '♪ Opet si kod svog telefona' : '♪ ' + poss(nameOf(st.owner)) + ' telefon svira ' + (d > 45 ? 'negde daleko' : 'na ' + Math.round(d) + ' m od tebe'), 3.2);
    }
    const n = sp.n, c = sp.ctx;
    if (n && c) {
      if (c.state === 'suspended' && now - sp.rs > 500) { sp.rs = now; c.resume().catch(() => {}); }
      const t = c.currentTime, L = c.listener, P = (p, v) => { if (p) p.setValueAtTime(v, t); };
      if (L.positionX) { P(L.positionX, me.x); P(L.positionY, ey); P(L.positionZ, me.z); P(L.forwardX, fx); P(L.forwardY, 0); P(L.forwardZ, fz); P(L.upX, 0); P(L.upY, 1); P(L.upZ, 0); }
      else { try { L.setPosition(me.x, ey, me.z); L.setOrientation(fx, 0, fz, 0, 1, 0); } catch (_) {} }
      const pn = n.pn;
      if (pn.positionX) { P(pn.positionX, sx); P(pn.positionY, sy); P(pn.positionZ, sz); } else { try { pn.setPosition(sx, sy, sz); } catch (_) {} }
      n.vg.gain.setTargetAtTime(.95 * amp * g, t, .06);
      n.lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(Math.max(450, 3300 - Math.min(2300, d * 60)) * (sp.blocked ? .5 : 1), t, .15);
    } else a.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, amp * g));
    if (now - sp.ui > 250) { sp.ui = now; const tx = spText(); root.querySelectorAll('.kp-sp').forEach(e => { if (e.textContent !== tx) e.textContent = tx; }); }
  }
  function togglePlay() {
    const a = st.audio; if (!a) return;
    if (a.paused) { const p = a.play(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {}); } else a.pause();
  }
  function tube() {
    const sg = SG();
    shell('<span style="color:#ff2d2d">▶</span> PeraTube', (B, app) => {
      if (!sg) { B.innerHTML = '<p>Pesme nisu učitane.</p>'; return; }
      B.innerHTML = '<input type="search" placeholder="Pretraži pesmu" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false"><div class="kp-list"></div>';
      const I = B.querySelector('input'), L = B.querySelector('.kp-list');
      const list = () => {
        const n = norm(I.value), r = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < sg.count; i++) { const t = norm(sg.title(i) + ' ' + sg.artist(i)); if (!n || t.includes(n) || n.split(' ').every(w => t.includes(w))) r.push(i); }
        L.innerHTML = (r.length ? (n ? '' : '<small>Predlozi za tebe</small>') : '<p style="text-align:center;color:#b3b4be;margin-top:2em">Nema rezultata.<br>Za sada su ovde samo pesme iz igre.</p>') +
          r.map(i => '<div class="kp-c" data-i="' + i + '"><div class="kp-th">' + (st.song === i && isPlaying() ? '♪' : '▶') + '</div><div><b>' + esc(sg.title(i)) + '</b><small>' + esc(sg.artist(i)) + ' · Pesma</small></div></div>').join('');
        L.querySelectorAll('[data-i]').forEach(x => x.onclick = () => { I.blur(); playView(+x.dataset.i); });
      };
      I.oninput = list; I.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') I.blur(); };
      list();
      if (st.song >= 0 && st.audio) { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'kp-btn'; b.style.cssText = 'width:100%;margin:.2em 0 .5em;background:#321616;border:1px solid #ff6b5f'; b.textContent = '⏹ UGASI MUZIKU'; b.onclick = () => { stopMusic(); tube(); }; B.insertBefore(b, L); }
    });
  }
  function playView(i, resume) {
    const sg = SG(); if (!sg) return;
    if (!resume || st.song !== i || !st.audio) {
      stopMusic();
      const a = new Audio(sg.src(i)); a.volume = .85; a.preload = 'auto';
      st.audio = a; st.song = i; spatialAttach(a);
      const p = a.play(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => { const e = screen.querySelector('.kp-err'); if (e) e.textContent = 'Dodirni ▶ da pustiš pesmu.'; });
    }
    const a = st.audio, hk = sg.hook(i);
    shell('<span style="color:#ff2d2d">▶</span> PeraTube', B => {
      B.innerHTML = '<div class="kp-pp"><div class="kp-big"><canvas class="kp-vz"></canvas></div><b style="font-size:1.15em">' + esc(sg.title(i)) + '</b><br><small>' + esc(sg.artist(i)) + '</small><div class="kp-bar2"><div></div><span></span></div><div class="kp-r"><span class="c1">0:00</span><span class="d1">0:00</span></div><div class="kp-k"><button type="button" class="pl">⏸</button>' + (hk ? '<button type="button" class="hk">🔥</button>' : '') + '<button type="button" class="bk2">Nazad</button></div>' + volHtml() + '<p class="kp-hk"></p><p class="kp-err" style="color:#ff8a80;font-size:.9em"></p></div>';
      const big = B.querySelector('.kp-big'), bar = B.querySelector('.kp-bar2 div'), seg = B.querySelector('.kp-bar2 span'), c1 = B.querySelector('.c1'), d1 = B.querySelector('.d1'), pl = B.querySelector('.pl'), hl = B.querySelector('.kp-hk');
      const sync = () => {
        pl.textContent = a.paused ? '▶' : '⏸'; big.classList.toggle('off', a.paused);
        c1.textContent = fmt(a.currentTime); if (a.duration) { d1.textContent = fmt(a.duration); bar.style.width = (a.currentTime / a.duration * 100) + '%'; if (hk) { seg.style.left = hk[0] / a.duration * 100 + '%'; seg.style.width = Math.max(1.5, (hk[1] - hk[0]) / a.duration * 100) + '%'; } }
        if (hk) { const on = a.currentTime >= hk[0] && a.currentTime <= hk[1]; hl.textContent = on ? '🔥 NAJBOLJI DEO · svi pevaju!' : '🔥 Najbolji deo: ' + fmt(hk[0]) + '–' + fmt(hk[1]); }
      };
      a.onerror = () => { const e = B.querySelector('.kp-err'); if (e) e.textContent = 'Ova pesma još nije ubačena u igru.'; };
      a.ontimeupdate = sync; a.onplay = a.onpause = a.onloadedmetadata = a.onended = sync;
      pl.onclick = () => { togglePlay(); sync(); };
      const hb = B.querySelector('.hk'); if (hb) hb.onclick = () => { a.currentTime = Math.max(0, hk[0] - 2); const p = a.play(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {}); sync(); };
      B.querySelector('.kp-bar2').onclick = e => { const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(); if (a.duration) a.currentTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(a.duration - .5, (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * a.duration)); };
      B.querySelector('.bk2').onclick = tube; wireVol(B);
      sync();
    });
  }

  function wgTick() {
    const t = root.querySelector('.kp-wt'), d = root.querySelector('.kp-wd'); if (!t || !d) return;
    const gt = ((document.getElementById('betaTime') || {}).textContent || '').trim();
    t.textContent = /^\d{1,2}:\d{2}/.test(gt) ? gt.slice(0, 5) : new Date().toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
    let ds = ''; try { ds = new Date().toLocaleDateString('sr-Latn-RS', {weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long'}); } catch (_) {}
    if (d.textContent !== ds) d.textContent = ds;
  }

  /* ---------- vizualizator muzike (stvarni spektar pesme) ---------- */
  const vz = {raf: 0, data: null, g: new Map()};
  function vzKick() { if (!vz.raf && st.open) vz.raf = requestAnimationFrame(vzTick); }
  function vzTick(now) {
    vz.raf = 0;
    if (!st.open) return;
    const cs = root.querySelectorAll('canvas.kp-vz'); if (!cs.length) return;
    vz.raf = requestAnimationFrame(vzTick);
    const playing = isPlaying(), an = sp.n && sp.n.an, bars = 22;
    if (an) { if (!vz.data || vz.data.length !== an.frequencyBinCount) vz.data = new Uint8Array(an.frequencyBinCount); an.getByteFrequencyData(vz.data); }
    cs.forEach(cv => {
      const w = cv.clientWidth, h = cv.clientHeight; if (!w || !h) return;
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1), W = Math.round(w * dpr), Hh = Math.round(h * dpr);
      if (cv.width !== W || cv.height !== Hh) { cv.width = W; cv.height = Hh; }
      const g = cv.getContext('2d'); g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0); g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      const hero = !cv.classList.contains('mini'), bw = w / bars;
      const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, h, 0, 0); gr.addColorStop(0, '#ff4fa3'); gr.addColorStop(1, hero ? '#fff0b0' : '#ffd37a'); g.fillStyle = gr;
      for (let i = 0; i < bars; i++) {
        let v;
        if (an && playing && vz.data) v = Math.pow(vz.data[Math.min(vz.data.length - 1, 1 + Math.floor(Math.pow(i / bars, 1.7) * vz.data.length * .38))] / 255, 1.35);
        else v = playing ? .2 + .2 * Math.sin(now / 170 + i * .8) : .04;
        const bh = Math.max(2, v * h * (hero ? .92 : 1)), x = i * bw + bw * .18, ww = bw * .64;
        if (hero) g.fillRect(x, (h - bh) / 2, ww, bh); else g.fillRect(x, h - bh, ww, bh);
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Kamera / Galerija ---------- */
  const FILT = [['Normalno', 'none'], ['Retro', 'sepia(.55) saturate(1.5) contrast(1.08) brightness(1.05)'], ['Noć', 'brightness(.85) contrast(1.25) saturate(1.2) hue-rotate(185deg)'], ['Crno-belo', 'grayscale(1) contrast(1.15)']];
  function photos() {
    if (!st.photos) {
      try { const a = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kb_phone_photos') || '[]'); st.photos = Array.isArray(a) ? a.filter(x => typeof x === 'string' && /^data:image\/jpeg;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(x)).slice(-12) : []; } catch (_) { st.photos = []; }
    }
    return st.photos;
  }
  function savePhotos() {
    const ph = photos();
    for (;;) { try { localStorage.setItem('kb_phone_photos', JSON.stringify(ph)); return; } catch (_) { if (ph.length <= 1) return; ph.shift(); } }
  }
  function shutterSound() {
    try {
      const c = phCtx(); if (!c) return; if (c.state === 'suspended') c.resume().catch(() => {});
      [0, .085].forEach((d, k) => {
        const n = Math.floor(c.sampleRate * .05), b = c.createBuffer(1, n, c.sampleRate), x = b.getChannelData(0);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) x[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.pow(1 - i / n, 3);
        const s = c.createBufferSource(), f = c.createBiquadFilter(), g = c.createGain();
        s.buffer = b; f.type = 'bandpass'; f.frequency.value = k ? 1800 : 3000; f.Q.value = .9; g.gain.value = .45;
        s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(c.destination); s.start(c.currentTime + d);
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  function drawCrop(g, scn, W, Hh) {
    const ta = W / Hh, sw0 = scn.width, sh0 = scn.height;
    let ch = sh0 / st.zoom, cw = ch * ta; if (cw > sw0 / st.zoom) { cw = sw0 / st.zoom; ch = cw / ta; }
    g.drawImage(scn, (sw0 - cw) / 2, (sh0 - ch) / 2, cw, ch, 0, 0, W, Hh);
  }
  function vfDraw() {
    const v = st.vf; if (!v || !v.cv.isConnected) { st.vf = null; return; }
    const scn = document.getElementById('kbGeo3D'); if (!scn || !scn.width) return;
    const cv = v.cv, W = cv.clientWidth | 0, Hh = cv.clientHeight | 0; if (!W || !Hh) return;
    if (cv.width !== W || cv.height !== Hh) { cv.width = W; cv.height = Hh; }
    try { drawCrop(cv.getContext('2d'), scn, W, Hh); } catch (_) {}
    if (st.snap) { st.snap = 0; takePhoto(scn); }
  }
  function takePhoto(scn) {
    const v = st.vf, h = H(); if (!v) return;
    const ta = (v.cv.width || 3) / (v.cv.height || 4), W = 540, Hh = Math.round(W / ta);
    const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = W; c.height = Hh;
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    try { if ('filter' in g) g.filter = FILT[st.filt][1]; } catch (_) {}
    let url = '';
    try { drawCrop(g, scn, W, Hh); url = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', .82); } catch (_) { if (h && h.tip) h.tip('📷 Slika nije uspela', 2); return; }
    const ph = photos(); ph.push(url); while (ph.length > 12) ph.shift(); savePhotos();
    if (v.fl && v.fl.isConnected) { v.fl.classList.remove('go'); void v.fl.offsetWidth; v.fl.classList.add('go'); }
    if (v.thumb) v.thumb();
    shutterSound();
    if (h && h.tip) h.tip('📸 Slika sačuvana u Galeriji (' + ph.length + ')', 2.2);
  }

    });
  }
  function thread(id) {
    st.thread = id; st.unread = 0; updateBadge();
    const arr = st.threads[id];
    shell(id === 'misija' ? 'Misija' : 'Ekipa 🔥', (B, app) => {
      B.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0';

      const add = m => { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'kp-m' + (m.me ? ' me' : ''); if (!m.me) { const s = document.createElement('small'); s.textContent = m.who; d.appendChild(s); } d.appendChild(document.createTextNode(m.text)); M.appendChild(d); M.scrollTop = 1e9; };
      arr.forEach(add);
      if (!arr.length) M.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#9a9ba5;text-align:center;margin-top:2em">Poruke vezane za misiju stižu ovde.</p>';
      if (id === 'ekipa') {

      }
    });
  }
  function deliver(from, text) {

    if (st.threads.misija.length > 60) st.threads.misija.shift();
    if (st.open && st.app === 'msg' && st.thread === 'misija') { thread('misija'); return; }
    st.unread++; st.buzz = 6; ding(); updateBadge();

  }

  /* --- Zadaci / GPS --- */
  function current() {
    const h = H(); if (!h) return null;
    const ext = [window.KBB1Runtime, window.KBB2Runtime].find(r => r && r.active);
    const a = h.actors && h.actors[h.active];
    if (ext) {
      try {
        const d = ext.debug(), def = (ext === window.KBB1Runtime ? window.KBB1Chapter : window.KBB2Chapter).definition(), s = def.stages[d.stage] || {};
        return {no: 'POGLAVLJE', title: def.title, task: (s.title ? s.title + '. ' : '') + (s.hint || ''), step: d.stage, n: def.stages.length, target: d.target, dist: a && d.target ? Math.hypot(d.target.x - a.x, d.target.z - a.z) : null, a, h, loc: def.location};
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    const t = h.task;
    if (h.story && h.story.on && t) {
      const q = id => (document.getElementById(id) || {}).textContent || '';
      return {no: q('betaChapterNo'), title: q('betaChapterTitle'), task: t.text, step: h.story.step, n: [8, 6, 3][h.story.chapter] || 0, target: t, dist: a ? Math.hypot(t.x - a.x, t.z - a.z) : null, a, h};
    }
    return {no: '', title: '', task: '', target: null, dist: null, a, h};
  }
  function dirOf(c) {
    if (!c || !c.target || !c.a) return {deg: 0, name: ''};
    const rad = Math.atan2(c.target.x - c.a.x, c.target.z - c.a.z) - c.h.yaw, TAU = Math.PI * 2;
    return {deg: rad * 180 / Math.PI, name: ['NAPRED', 'DESNO', 'IZA TEBE', 'LEVO'][(Math.round((rad + TAU * 4) / TAU * 4) % 4 + 4) % 4]};
  }
  function task() {
    shell('Zadaci', B => {
      const draw = () => {
        const c = current();
        if (!c || !c.title && !c.task) { B.innerHTML = '<div class="kp-card"><h4>Nema aktivnog zadatka</h4><p>U slobodnoj igri istražuj kraj. Pokreni priču da dobiješ zadatke.</p></div>'; return; }
        const d = dirOf(c);
        const pr = c.n ? '<div class="kp-bar2" style="margin:.5em 0 .2em;cursor:default"><div style="width:' + Math.round((c.step) / c.n * 100) + '%;background:#d8be7f"></div></div><small>Faza ' + Math.min(c.n, c.step + 1) + ' / ' + c.n + '</small>' : '';
        B.innerHTML = '<div class="kp-card"><small>' + esc(c.no) + '</small><h4>' + esc(c.title) + '</h4><p>' + esc(c.task) + '</p>' + pr + '</div>' +
          (c.target ? '<div class="kp-card kp-comp"><div class="kp-arr" style="transform:rotate(' + d.deg.toFixed(0) + 'deg)">↑</div><div><b style="font-size:1.3em">' + Math.round(c.dist) + ' m</b><br><small>' + d.name + '</small></div></div>' : '') +
          (c.loc ? '<div class="kp-card"><small>Lokacija</small><p>' + esc(c.loc) + '</p></div>' : '') +
          '<p><small>Zlatni marker u svetu pokazuje cilj. M otvara kartu.</small></p>';
      };
      draw(); st.timer = setInterval(() => { if (st.open && st.app === 'task') draw(); }, 400);
    });
  }
  function gps() {

'<div class="kp-card kp-comp"><div class="kp-arr" style="transform:rotate(' + d.deg.toFixed(0) + 'deg)">↑</div><div><small>Cilj misije</small><br><b style="font-size:1.3em">' + Math.round(c.dist) + ' m</b> · <small>' + d.name + '</small></div></div>' : '<div class="kp-card"><p>Nema zadatog cilja.</p></div>') +

  function key(k) {
    try { ['keydown', 'keyup'].forEach(t => document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(t, {key: k, bubbles: true, cancelable: true}))); } catch (_) {}
  }
  function lamp() {

  function calc() {
    shell('Kalkulator', B => {
      let cur = '0', acc = null, op = null, fr = 1;
      B.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:.6em';
      B.innerHTML = '<div class="kp-dp">0</div><div class="kp-kp"></div>';
      const D = B.querySelector('.kp-dp'), G = B.querySelector('.kp-kp');
      const run = () => { if (op == null || acc == null) return; const x = +cur; acc = op == '+' ? acc + x : op == '−' ? acc - x : op == '×' ? acc * x : (x ? acc / x : NaN); cur = String(+acc.toFixed(8)); if (cur == 'NaN') cur = 'Greška'; };
      const press = k => {
        if (cur == 'Greška' && k != 'C') return;
        if ('0123456789'.includes(k)) { cur = (fr || cur == '0') ? k : cur + k; fr = 0; }
        else if (k == '.') { if (fr) { cur = '0.'; fr = 0; } else if (!cur.includes('.')) cur += '.'; }
        else if (k == 'C') { cur = '0'; acc = op = null; fr = 1; }
        else if (k == '±') cur = String(-cur);
        else if (k == '=') { run(); op = null; acc = null; fr = 1; }
        else { if (op && !fr) run(); acc = +cur; op = k; fr = 1; }
        D.textContent = cur;
      };
      ['C', '±', '÷', '×', '7', '8', '9', '−', '4', '5', '6', '+', '1', '2', '3', '=', '0', '.'].forEach(k => { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = k; if ('÷×−+='.includes(k)) b.className = 'o'; b.onclick = () => press(k); G.appendChild(b); });
    });
  }
  function clock() {
    shell('Sat', B => {
      B.style.cssText = 'padding:1em;text-align:center';
      B.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:2.6em;font-weight:700;margin:.4em 0" class="ck"></div><small>Kalač brdo · vreme u igri <span class="ig"></span></small><h4>Štoperica</h4><div style="font-size:2em;margin:.4em 0 .8em" class="sw">0:00.0</div><div><button type="button" class="kp-btn s1">START</button> <button type="button" class="kp-btn s2">RESET</button></div>';
      const C = B.querySelector('.ck'), S = B.querySelector('.sw'), b1 = B.querySelector('.s1'), ig = B.querySelector('.ig');
      let t0 = 0, acc = 0, run = 0;
      const f = () => { C.textContent = new Date().toTimeString().slice(0, 8); const t = acc + (run ? Date.now() - t0 : 0); S.textContent = Math.floor(t / 60000) + ':' + String(Math.floor(t / 1000) % 60).padStart(2, '0') + '.' + Math.floor(t / 100) % 10; ig.textContent = (document.getElementById('betaTime') || {}).textContent || ''; };
      b1.onclick = () => { if (run) { acc += Date.now() - t0; run = 0; b1.textContent = 'START'; } else { t0 = Date.now(); run = 1; b1.textContent = 'STOP'; } };
      B.querySelector('.s2').onclick = () => { acc = 0; run = 0; t0 = Date.now(); b1.textContent = 'START'; };
      st.timer = setInterval(f, 100); f();
    });
  }

  /* ---------- otvaranje / zatvaranje ---------- */
  function updateBadge() {

  }
  function otherDialog() {
    const sh = id => { const e = document.getElementById(id); return !!(e && !e.hidden && getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none'); };
    const c = H() && H().cine;

  }
  function open() {
    const h = H();
    if (st.open || !h || !h.live || h.paused || otherDialog()) return false;
    if (h.active !== st.holder) { try { h.tip('📱 Telefon je kod ' + (['Andreja', 'Lazara', 'Pere', 'Vuka'][st.holder] || 'drugog lika') + (st.holder === 3 ? ' · uzmi ga od Vuka (E kod njega)' : ' · pređi na njega'), 3.2); } catch (_) {} return false; }
    st.open = true; st.buzz = 0;
    try { h.clearInput(); } catch (_) {}
    try { if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock(); } catch (_) {}
    root.classList.add('on'); root.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false'); gm.classList.add('kb-phone-on'); dim.classList.add('on');
    timeEl.textContent = (document.getElementById('betaTime') || {}).textContent || new Date().toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
    if (st.app === 'tube' && st.song >= 0 && st.audio) playView(st.song, true); else home();
    return true;
  }
  function close() {
    if (!st.open) return false;
    st.open = false; clearInterval(st.timer);
    const ae = document.activeElement; if (ae && root.contains(ae)) ae.blur();
    root.classList.remove('on'); root.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); gm.classList.remove('kb-phone-on'); dim.classList.remove('on'); st.vf = null;
    const h = H(); try { h && h.clearInput(); } catch (_) {}
    try { document.getElementById('gm').querySelector('canvas').focus({preventScroll: true}); } catch (_) {}
    return true;
  }
  function toggle() { return st.open ? close() : open(); }
  root.querySelector('.kp-x').onclick = close;
  root.querySelector('.kp-home').onclick = home;
  function stop() { close(); stopMusic(); st.holder = 0; st.sent.clear(); st.threads.misija.length = 0; st.unread = 0; st.app = ''; st.peek = st.rise = 0; updateBadge(); }

  /* dugme na HUD-u (mobilni + miš) */
  function mountButton() {
    const u = document.getElementById('betaUtility'); if (!u || document.getElementById('betaPhone')) return;
    const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.id = 'betaPhone'; b.textContent = 'TELEFON · H';
