  }
  mountButton();
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden && st.audio && !st.audio.paused) { try { st.audio.pause(); } catch (_) {} } });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (!st.audio || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
    const tg = e.target; if (tg && (tg.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(tg.tagName))) return;
    const h = H(); if (!h || !h.live) return;
    if (e.key === '-' || e.key === '_') setVol(st.vol - .1, true); else if (e.key === '+' || e.key === '=') setVol(st.vol + .1, true); else return;
    e.preventDefault();
  });

  /* ---------- praćenje misije → poruke ---------- */
  function watch() {
    const h = H(); if (!h || !h.live) return;
    let keyName = '';
    const ext = [window.KBB1Runtime, window.KBB2Runtime].find(r => r && r.active);
    if (ext) {
      try { const d = ext.debug(), def = (ext === window.KBB1Runtime ? window.KBB1Chapter : window.KBB2Chapter).definition(); if (!d.screen || d.screen === 'game') keyName = def.id + ':' + (def.stages[d.stage] || {}).id; } catch (_) {}
    } else if (h.story && h.story.on && !h.story.completed) keyName = h.story.chapter + ':' + h.story.step;
    if (!keyName || st.sent.has(keyName) || (window.KBVuk && window.KBVuk.on)) return;
    st.sent.add(keyName);
    (STORY[keyName] || []).forEach((m, i) => setTimeout(() => { const hh = H(); if (hh && hh.live) deliver(m[0], m[1]); }, 2200 + i * 1800));
  }

  /* ---------- model telefona u ruci (crta se kroz paintDynamic) ---------- */
  const U = 7.99; // tip 7.x: bez osvetljenja, providnost = tip - 7
  const linC = new Map();
  function lin(c) {
    let v = linC.get(c); if (v) return v;
    const n = parseInt(c.slice(1), 16), f = s => Math.round(Math.pow(s / 255, 2.2) / 1.6 * 255);
    v = '#' + ((1 << 24) + (f(n >> 16 & 255) << 16) + (f(n >> 8 & 255) << 8) + f(n & 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    linC.set(c, v); return v;
  }
  function build(m0, eye, X, Y, Z, k) {
    const m = k.r2 ? {quad: (a, b, c, d, col, t) => m0.quad(a, b, c, d, lin(col), t)} : m0;
    /* k: {rise, tilt, time, screen, bars, flash} · (cx,cy,cz) kamera-prostor: x desno, y gore, z nazad */
    const w = (cx, cy, cz) => [eye[0] + X[0] * cx + Y[0] * cy + Z[0] * cz, eye[1] + X[1] * cx + Y[1] * cy + Z[1] * cz, eye[2] + X[2] * cx + Y[2] * cy + Z[2] * cz];
    const rise = k.rise, lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
    const px = lerp(-.015, .07, rise), py = lerp(-.42 + k.peek * .15, -.075, rise), pz = lerp(-.46, -.36, rise);
    const rx = lerp(-.55, -.33, rise), rz = lerp(.28, .05, rise);
    const sway = Math.sin(k.time * 1.6) * .004, sway2 = Math.cos(k.time * 1.1) * .003;
    const cr = Math.cos(rx), sr = Math.sin(rx), cz = Math.cos(rz), sz = Math.sin(rz);
    // lokalno (telefon) -> kamera-prostor
    const P = (lx, ly, lz) => {
      let y1 = ly * cr - lz * sr, z1 = ly * sr + lz * cr, x1 = lx;
      const x2 = x1 * cz - y1 * sz, y2 = x1 * sz + y1 * cz;
      return w(px + x2 + sway2, py + y2 + sway, pz + z1);
    };
    const box = (cx, cy, cz2, bw, bh, bd, col) => {
      const a = cx - bw / 2, b = cx + bw / 2, c = cy - bh / 2, d = cy + bh / 2, e = cz2 - bd / 2, f = cz2 + bd / 2;
      const v = (x, y, z) => P(x, y, z);
      m.quad(v(a, d, f), v(b, d, f), v(b, c, f), v(a, c, f), col, U); // prednja
      m.quad(v(a, c, e), v(b, c, e), v(b, d, e), v(a, d, e), shade(col, .55), U); // zadnja
      m.quad(v(a, d, e), v(b, d, e), v(b, d, f), v(a, d, f), shade(col, 1.15), U); // gore
      m.quad(v(a, c, f), v(b, c, f), v(b, c, e), v(a, c, e), shade(col, .6), U); // dole
      m.quad(v(a, c, e), v(a, d, e), v(a, d, f), v(a, c, f), shade(col, .8), U); // levo
      m.quad(v(b, c, f), v(b, d, f), v(b, d, e), v(b, c, e), shade(col, .8), U); // desno
    };
    const rect = (cx, cy, bw, bh, col, zf) => { const a = cx - bw / 2, b = cx + bw / 2, c = cy - bh / 2, d = cy + bh / 2; m.quad(P(a, d, zf), P(b, d, zf), P(b, c, zf), P(a, c, zf), col, U); };
    // telo telefona i ekran
    box(0, 0, 0, .078, .158, .009, '#1b1c22');
    const z = .0051;
    rect(0, 0, .069, .149, k.bg, z);
    const sc = k.screen;
    if (sc === 'home') {
      rect(0, .062, .069, .018, '#0b0c10', z + .0002);
      for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) if (r * 4 + c < 8 + k.musicOn * 0) rect(-.025 + c * .0167, .036 - r * .03, .012, .012, ['#ff2d2d', '#3fc156', '#e4b34a', '#4aa3e4', '#8a8b96', '#ee2a7b', '#ff9f0a', '#5a5c68'][(r * 4 + c) % 8], z + .0002);
    } else if (sc === 'music') {
      rect(0, .045, .069, .04, '#b0192b', z + .0002);
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const hh = .012 + (.5 + .5 * Math.sin(k.time * (5 + i * 1.3) + i)) * .03; rect(-.024 + i * .012, -.004 - (.03 - hh) / 2 + .012, .007, hh, '#ffffff', z + .0003); }
      rect(0, -.045, .052, .004, '#3a3b44', z + .0002); rect(-.012, -.045, .028, .004, '#ff2d2d', z + .0003);
    } else if (sc === 'msg') {
      rect(0, .06, .069, .02, '#1f9d3a', z + .0002);
      rect(-.012, .028, .044, .014, '#26272e', z + .0002); rect(.012, .007, .044, .014, '#2f7bff', z + .0002); rect(-.014, -.014, .036, .014, '#26272e', z + .0002);
    }
    if (k.flash) rect(0, .06, .058, .013, '#33ff77', z + .0006); // obaveštenje
    // ruka: dlan iza, prsti oko ivice, palac preko ekrana
    const sk = '#c8946b', sk2 = '#b27d56', sl = '#3d5a45';
    box(.002, -.07, -.016, .07, .08, .02, sk2);
    box(.044, .012, -.005, .014, .024, .018, sk); box(.044, -.016, -.005, .014, .024, .018, sk); box(.043, -.044, -.005, .013, .022, .018, sk2);
    box(-.03, -.062, .008, .02, .05, .011, sk); box(-.027, -.04, .0105, .016, .02, .009, '#d6a27a');
    // podlaktica
    const lim = (ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, wd, col) => {
      const A = [ax, ay, az], B = [bx, by, bz], d = [B[0] - A[0], B[1] - A[1], B[2] - A[2]], L = Math.hypot(...d) || 1, n = d.map(q => q / L);
      let u = [n[1] * 1 - n[2] * 0, n[2] * 0 - n[0] * 1, 0]; const ul = Math.hypot(...u) || 1; u = u.map(q => q / ul * wd / 2);
      const v = [n[1] * u[2] - n[2] * u[1], n[2] * u[0] - n[0] * u[2], n[0] * u[1] - n[1] * u[0]];
      const pt = (p, s, t) => w(p[0] + u[0] * s + v[0] * t, p[1] + u[1] * s + v[1] * t, p[2] + u[2] * s + v[2] * t);
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) { m.quad(pt(A, s, -1), pt(B, s, -1), pt(B, s, 1), pt(A, s, 1), col, U); m.quad(pt(A, -1, s), pt(B, -1, s), pt(B, 1, s), pt(A, 1, s), shade(col, .8), U); }
    };
    const a0 = [px + .01, py - .13, pz - .02], a1 = [px + .17, py - .42, pz + .14];
    lim(a0[0], a0[1], a0[2], a1[0], a1[1], a1[2], .075, sl);
    lim(a0[0], a0[1], a0[2], px + .02 + (a1[0] - a0[0]) * .22, py - .13 + (a1[1] - a0[1]) * .22, pz - .02 + (a1[2] - a0[2]) * .22, .082, '#35503c');
  }
  function shade(c, f) {
    const n = parseInt(c.slice(1), 16), r = Math.min(255, Math.round((n >> 16 & 255) * f)), g = Math.min(255, Math.round((n >> 8 & 255) * f)), b = Math.min(255, Math.round((n & 255) * f));
    return '#' + ((1 << 24) + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1);
  }
  function paint(m, c) {
    const h = H(); if (!h || !h.live) return;
    if (st.vf || st.snap) { if (st.snap || (++st.vfn & 1)) Promise.resolve().then(vfDraw); }
    const now = c.time, dt = Math.min(.1, Math.max(0, now - st.lastT)); st.lastT = now;
    st.poll -= dt; if (st.poll <= 0) { st.poll = .6; mountButton(); watch(); }
    if (st.open && st.poll > .55 && otherDialog()) close();
    if (st.open && (now | 0) % 20 === 0) { const tt = document.getElementById('betaTime'); if (tt && tt.textContent) timeEl.textContent = tt.textContent; }
    st.buzz = Math.max(0, st.buzz - dt);
    const playing = isPlaying();
    st.rise += ((st.open ? 1 : 0) - st.rise) * Math.min(1, dt * 7); if (st.hold != null) { st.rise = st.hold; st.peek = 1; }
    const mine = h.active === st.holder; st.peek += (((!st.open && mine && (st.buzz > 0 || playing)) ? 1 : 0) - st.peek) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
    if (!mine) { st.peek = 0; return; }
    if (c.interior || c.football) return;
    if (c.view !== 0) return; // u 3. licu kamera je predaleko; tu ostaje samo telefon na ekranu
    if (st.open && st.rise > .93) return;
    if (st.rise < .02 && st.peek < .03) return;
    const a = c.p;
    let eye, X, Y, Z;
    {
      eye = c.cam.eye; let z = [eye[0] - c.cam.target[0], eye[1] - c.cam.target[1], eye[2] - c.cam.target[2]], l = Math.hypot(...z) || 1; z = z.map(q => q / l);
      let x = [z[2], 0, -z[0]]; l = Math.hypot(...x) || 1; x = x.map(q => q / l);
      const y = [z[1] * x[2] - z[2] * x[1], z[2] * x[0] - z[0] * x[2], z[0] * x[1] - z[1] * x[0]];
      X = x; Y = y; Z = z;
    }
    const sc = !st.open && !st.peek ? 'home' : (playing ? 'music' : (st.buzz > 0 ? 'msg' : (st.app === 'msg' ? 'msg' : 'home')));
    build(m, eye, X, Y, Z, {r2: !!c.r2, rise: st.rise, peek: st.peek, time: now, screen: sc, bg: sc === 'music' ? '#2a0d3f' : sc === 'msg' ? '#12151c' : '#26407a', flash: st.buzz > 0 && ((now * 3 | 0) % 2 === 0), musicOn: playing ? 1 : 0});
  }

  window.KBPhone3D = Object.freeze({
    open, close, toggle, stop, paint,
    cinemaHold: () => { const was=!!(st.audio&&!st.audio.paused);if(was)try{st.audio.pause()}catch(_){}return was; },
    cinemaRelease: (was) => { if(was&&st.audio&&st.audio.paused&&!document.hidden)try{st.audio.play().catch(()=>{})}catch(_){} },
    busy: () => !!(st.open || st.rise > .02 || (st.peek > .03 && st.buzz > 0)), isOpen: () => st.open, holder: () => st.holder, setHolder: i => { st.holder = i; const hh = H(); if (st.open && hh && hh.active !== i) close(); }, silence: stopMusic, nowPlaying: () => st.audio ? {i: st.song, t: st.audio.currentTime, playing: isPlaying()} : null, push: deliver, hold: v => { st.hold = v; }, volume: v => { if (v != null) setVol(v); return st.vol; },
    debug: () => ({photos: (st.photos || []).length, vf: !!st.vf, vol: st.vol, owner: st.owner, holder: st.holder, dist: sp.d, gain: sp.g, mine: sp.mine, blocked: sp.blocked, spatial: !!sp.n, ctx: sp.ctx ? sp.ctx.state : null, open: st.open, rise: st.rise, peek: st.peek, song: st.song, playing: isPlaying(), unread: st.unread, app: st.app, sent: [...st.sent], msgs: st.threads.misija.length})
  });
})();
</script>
<script id="kb-touch-hud">
/* KALAČ BRDO · Dodirne kontrole + novi HUD (v10)
   - plutajući džojstik: pojavljuje se pod palcem, mrtva zona, kriva odziva, "magnetne" ose, trk na ivici
   - pogled: glačanje + blaga akceleracija, osetljivost podesiva
   - raspored dugmadi za palac, kontekstualno dugme E, ikone u SVG-u
   - pun ekran + zaključavanje na pejzaž (Android), uputstvo za iPhone
   Modul ne dira pravila igre: pokreće isti kod kao tasteri (KBInput u runtime-u + klik na postojeća dugmad). */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const gm = document.getElementById('gm');
  if (!gm || window.KBTouchHud) return;
  const H = () => (window.KBMissionDirector && window.KBMissionDirector.adapters && window.KBMissionDirector.adapters.host('3d')) || null;
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const txt = id => { const e = $(id); return e ? (e.textContent || '').trim() : ''; };
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
  const store = {
    get(k, d) { try { const v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v == null ? d : v; } catch (_) { return d; } },
    set(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem(k, String(v)); } catch (_) {} }
  };
  const coarseMQ = matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)');
  let touchMode = coarseMQ.matches;
  let sens = clamp(parseFloat(store.get('kb_touch_sens', '1')) || 1, .5, 1.8);
  let haptics = store.get('kb_touch_haptics', '1') !== '0';

    toast: q('.toast'), sl: q('.sl input'), sv: q('.sv'), full: q('[data-t=full]'), phone: q('[data-t=phone]'), lamp: q('[data-t=lamp]'), cam: q('[data-t=cam]')

  /* ---------- tipke ---------- */
  const key = (k, hold) => {
    try {
      const o = {key: k, bubbles: true, cancelable: true};
      document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', o));
      setTimeout(() => document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', o)), hold || 40);
    } catch (_) {}
  };
  const click = id => { const e = $(id); if (e && !e.disabled) { e.click(); return true; } return false; };
  let toastT = 0;
  function toast(t) { el.toast.textContent = t; el.toast.classList.add('on'); clearTimeout(toastT); toastT = setTimeout(() => el.toast.classList.remove('on'), 1500); }

  /* ---------- stanje i vidljivost ---------- */
  let on = false, moveActive = false, runLock = false, moving = false;
  const dialogSel = '#betaPause:not([hidden]),#kbB1Panel,#kbB2Panel,#cineDecision,#kbJournal,.kb-journal,#modal:not([hidden])';
  function visible(e) { if (!e) return false; const s = getComputedStyle(e); if (s.display === 'none' || s.visibility === 'hidden' || +s.opacity === 0) return false; const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 4 && r.height > 4; }
  function panelOpen() {
    for (const e of gm.querySelectorAll(dialogSel)) if (!root.contains(e) && visible(e) && !e.hidden) return true;
    for (const e of gm.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')) if (!root.contains(e) && e.id !== 'kbPhone3D' && !e.hidden && e.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true' && visible(e)) return true;
    return false;
  }
  function shouldShow() {
    const h = H(); if (!h || !h.live || h.paused) return false;
    if (h.football || h.mini) return false;
    if (gm.classList.contains('beta-map-open') || gm.classList.contains('beta-football')) return false;
    if (window.KBPhone3D && window.KBPhone3D.isOpen && window.KBPhone3D.isOpen()) return false;
    const c = h.cine; if (c && (c.wire && c.wire.open || c.tuning || c.choice)) return false;
    return !panelOpen();
  }
  function setOn(v) {
    if (v === on) return; on = v;
    root.classList.toggle('on', v); gm.classList.toggle('kbt-on', v); document.body.classList.toggle('kbt-on', v);
    if (window.KBInput) window.KBInput.own(v && touchMode);
    if (!v) { releaseStick(); releaseLook(); setMore(false); }
  }

  /* ---------- džojstik ---------- */
  const S = {id: null, ax: 0, ay: 0, hx: 0, hy: 0, edgeT: 0, run: false};
  const R = () => clamp(Math.min(innerWidth, innerHeight) * .15, 46, 74);
  const idleStick = () => { const r = zl.getBoundingClientRect(); const rr = R(); S.hx = r.left + clamp(r.width * .3, rr + 14, 190); S.hy = r.bottom - clamp(r.height * .32, rr + 12, 150); placeStick(S.hx, S.hy); };
  function placeStick(x, y) {
    const b = gm.getBoundingClientRect(); stickEl.style.left = (x - b.left) + 'px'; stickEl.style.top = (y - b.top) + 'px';
    const sz = R() * 2 + 'px'; stickEl.style.width = sz; stickEl.style.height = sz; stickEl.style.margin = '-' + R() + 'px 0 0 -' + R() + 'px';
  }
  function stickMove(e) {
    const rr = R(); let dx = e.clientX - S.ax, dy = e.clientY - S.ay, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (d > rr) { const k = (d - rr) / d; S.ax += dx * k; S.ay += dy * k; dx = e.clientX - S.ax; dy = e.clientY - S.ay; d = Math.hypot(dx, dy); placeStick(S.ax, S.ay); }
    const m = Math.min(1, d / rr), dead = .1;
    let out = 0, ux = 0, uy = 0;
    if (m > dead) {
      out = Math.pow((m - dead) / (1 - dead), 1.35);
      let a = Math.atan2(dy, dx); const q90 = Math.PI / 2, n = Math.round(a / q90) * q90;
      if (Math.abs(a - n) < .09) a = n; // magnetne ose: ravno napred/nazad/levo/desno
      ux = Math.cos(a); uy = Math.sin(a);
    }
    const now = performance.now();
    if (m > .965) { if (!S.edgeT) S.edgeT = now; }
    else { S.edgeT = 0; if (m < .8) S.run = false; }
    S.vx = ux * out; S.vz = uy * out;
    knob.style.transform = 'translate(' + (dx / rr * rr * .78 * (d > rr ? rr / d : 1)) + 'px,' + (dy / rr * rr * .78 * (d > rr ? rr / d : 1)) + 'px)';
    stickEl.classList.toggle('run', S.run);
  }
  function releaseStick() {
    S.id = null; S.run = false; S.edgeT = 0; S.vx = S.vz = 0; moving = false;
    stickEl.classList.remove('live', 'run'); knob.style.transform = '';
    if (window.KBInput) window.KBInput.move(0, 0, false);
    idleStick();
  }
  S.vx = S.vz = 0;
  zl.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    if (S.id !== null || !touchMode) return;
    e.preventDefault(); S.id = e.pointerId; try { zl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    const rr = R(), r = zl.getBoundingClientRect();
    S.ax = clamp(e.clientX, r.left + rr * .9, r.right - rr * .4); S.ay = clamp(e.clientY, r.top + rr * .9, r.bottom - rr * .6);
    placeStick(S.ax, S.ay); stickEl.classList.add('live'); stickMove(e); buzz(4);
  });
  zl.addEventListener('pointermove', e => { if (e.pointerId === S.id) { e.preventDefault(); stickMove(e); } });
  ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture'].forEach(t => zl.addEventListener(t, e => { if (e.pointerId === S.id) releaseStick(); }));

  /* ---------- pogled ---------- */
  const Lk = {id: null, x: 0, y: 0, sx: 0, sy: 0, moved: false, px: 0, py: 0};
  function releaseLook() { Lk.id = null; Lk.px = Lk.py = 0; Lk.moved = false; }
  zr.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    if (Lk.id !== null || !touchMode) return;
    e.preventDefault(); Lk.id = e.pointerId; try { zr.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    Lk.x = Lk.sx = e.clientX; Lk.y = Lk.sy = e.clientY; Lk.moved = false;
  });
  zr.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
    if (e.pointerId !== Lk.id) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!Lk.moved) { if (Math.hypot(e.clientX - Lk.sx, e.clientY - Lk.sy) < 4) return; Lk.moved = true; Lk.x = e.clientX; Lk.y = e.clientY; return; }
    const ev = e.getCoalescedEvents ? e.getCoalescedEvents() : null, list = ev && ev.length ? ev : [e];
    for (const c of list) { Lk.px += c.clientX - Lk.x; Lk.py += c.clientY - Lk.y; Lk.x = c.clientX; Lk.y = c.clientY; }
  });
  ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture'].forEach(t => zr.addEventListener(t, e => { if (e.pointerId === Lk.id) releaseLook(); }));

  let lastF = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    const dt = Math.min(.05, Math.max(.001, (now - lastF) / 1000)); lastF = now;
    if (!on || !touchMode || !window.KBInput) return;
    // pogled: glačanje + akceleracija
    if (Lk.px || Lk.py) {
      const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 40), ax = Lk.px * k, ay = Lk.py * k; Lk.px -= ax; Lk.py -= ay;
      if (Math.abs(Lk.px) < .02) Lk.px = 0; if (Math.abs(Lk.py) < .02) Lk.py = 0;
      const sp = Math.hypot(ax, ay) / dt, accel = 1 + clamp((sp - 260) / 2600, 0, .75);
      const scale = clamp(Math.sqrt(844 / Math.max(innerWidth, innerHeight)), .8, 1.25);
      const rad = .0043 * sens * accel * scale;
      window.KBInput.look(ax * rad, ay * rad * .82);
    }
    // kretanje
    if (S.id !== null) {
      if (!S.run && S.edgeT && performance.now() - S.edgeT > 110) { S.run = true; stickEl.classList.add('run'); buzz(10); }
      const run = S.run || (runLock && (S.vx || S.vz));
      moving = !!(S.vx || S.vz);
      window.KBInput.move(S.vx, S.vz, run);
    } else if (runLock) { window.KBInput.move(0, 0, false); }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);

  /* ---------- dugmad ---------- */
  function press(b, down, up) {
    let id = null;
    b.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { if (id !== null) return; e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); id = e.pointerId; try { b.setPointerCapture(id); } catch (_) {} b.classList.add('dn'); buzz(6); down(e); });
    const end = e => { if (id === null || e.pointerId !== id) return; id = null; b.classList.remove('dn'); if (up) up(e); };
    ['pointerup', 'pointercancel', 'lostpointercapture'].forEach(t => b.addEventListener(t, end));
  }
  press(el.go, () => { if (!click('betaAction')) key('e'); });
  press(el.jump, () => key(' ', 90));
  const riding = () => { const h = H(); return !!(h && h.ride && h.ride.kind && !h.football); };

    () => { if (wheelie) { wheelie = false; document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: 'x', bubbles: true, cancelable: true})); } });
  press(el.crouch, () => { key('z'); });
  press(el.run, () => { runLock = !runLock; el.run.classList.toggle('on', runLock); toast(runLock ? 'Stalni trk · uključen' : 'Stalni trk · isključen'); });
  function setMore(v) { el.more.classList.toggle('on', v); gm.classList.toggle('kbt-more', v); }
  const act = {
    phone: () => { window.KBPhone3D && window.KBPhone3D.toggle(); },
    cam: () => { click('betaCamera'); },

  el.crew.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', e => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); buzz(8); const t = document.querySelector('[data-crew="' + b.dataset.c + '"]'); if (t && !t.disabled) t.click(); else toast('Taj lik trenutno nije dostupan'); }));
  qa('.more [data-m]').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); buzz(6); const m = b.dataset.m;
    if (m === 'haptic') { haptics = !haptics; store.set('kb_touch_haptics', haptics ? '1' : '0'); b.classList.toggle('on', haptics); toast('Vibracija ' + (haptics ? 'uključena' : 'isključena')); return; }
    if (m === 'mode') { key('t'); return; }
    if (m === 'gear') { click('bq'); toast(txt('bq').replace('GRAFIKA: ', 'Grafika · ')); return; }
    if (click(m)) { if (m !== 'betaAim') setMore(false); }
  }));
  const sync = () => { el.sl.value = Math.round(sens * 100); el.sv.textContent = Math.round(sens * 100) + '%'; };
  el.sl.addEventListener('input', () => { sens = clamp(el.sl.value / 100, .5, 1.8); store.set('kb_touch_sens', sens); sync(); });
  sync();
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { if (el.more.classList.contains('on') && !el.more.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest('[data-t=more]')) setMore(false); }, true);
  // ako se igra tastaturom/mišem (hibridni uređaji), prebaci ploču; dodir je prebaci nazad
  addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { if (e.pointerType === 'touch' && !touchMode) setMode(true); }, true);
  addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (touchMode && !coarseMQ.matches && /^(w|a|s|d|e|shift| )$/i.test(e.key)) setMode(false); }, true);
  function setMode(t) { touchMode = t; root.dataset.mode = t ? 'touch' : 'kbm'; if (window.KBInput) window.KBInput.own(on && t); if (!t) { releaseStick(); releaseLook(); } else idleStick(); }

  /* ---------- pun ekran ---------- */
  const fsEl = () => document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement;
  function canFS() { const d = document.documentElement; return !!(d.requestFullscreen || d.webkitRequestFullscreen); }
  const isIOS = /iP(hone|ad|od)/.test(navigator.userAgent) || (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
  const standalone = () => (window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(display-mode:standalone)').matches) || navigator.standalone === true;
  async function enterFS() {
    const d = document.documentElement; if (fsEl()) return;
    try {
      const r = (d.requestFullscreen || d.webkitRequestFullscreen).call(d, {navigationUI: 'hide'});
      if (r && r.then) await r;
      try { if (screen.orientation && screen.orientation.lock) await screen.orientation.lock('landscape'); } catch (_) {}
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  function exitFS() { try { (document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen).call(document); } catch (_) {} try { screen.orientation && screen.orientation.unlock && screen.orientation.unlock(); } catch (_) {} }
  function toggleFS() {
    if (!canFS()) {
      toast(isIOS ? (standalone() ? 'Već si u punom ekranu' : 'iPhone: Podeli ▸ Dodaj na početni ekran za pun ekran') : 'Ovaj pregledač ne podržava pun ekran');
      return;
    }
    if (fsEl()) exitFS(); else enterFS();
  }
  function fsIcon() { const f = !!fsEl(); el.full.innerHTML = svg(f ? 'fullx' : 'full'); el.full.classList.toggle('on', f); }
  ['fullscreenchange', 'webkitfullscreenchange'].forEach(t => document.addEventListener(t, fsIcon));
  // pun ekran automatski pri prvom dodiru posle početka igre (traži gest korisnika)
  let autoFS = store.get('kb_auto_fs', '1') !== '0', triedFS = false;
  addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
    if (!autoFS || triedFS || !on || !touchMode || e.pointerType === 'mouse' || fsEl() || !canFS()) return;
    triedFS = true; enterFS();
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => { if (!fsEl() && triedFS) { /* korisnik izašao – ne nameći ponovo, dugme je u meniju */ } });
  if (isIOS && !standalone() && touchMode) {
    // iPhone nema Fullscreen API: pokaži savet jednom
    let shown = store.get('kb_ios_tip', '0') === '1';
    const t = setInterval(() => { if (on && !shown) { shown = true; store.set('kb_ios_tip', '1'); toast('Za pun ekran: Podeli ▸ Dodaj na početni ekran'); clearInterval(t); } }, 3000);
  }
  // meta za instaliranu verziju (iPhone/Android): bez adresne trake
  (function meta() {
    const add = (n, c) => { if (!document.querySelector('meta[name="' + n + '"]')) { const m = document.createElement('meta'); m.name = n; m.content = c; document.head.appendChild(m); } };
    add('apple-mobile-web-app-capable', 'yes'); add('mobile-web-app-capable', 'yes'); add('apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style', 'black-translucent'); add('format-detection', 'telephone=no');
    const v = document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]');
    if (v && !/viewport-fit/.test(v.content)) v.content = v.content + ', viewport-fit=cover';
  })();

  /* ---------- osvežavanje HUD-a ---------- */
  function update() {
    const h = H();
    el.nm.textContent = txt('betaName') || 'ANDREJ'; el.av.textContent = (el.nm.textContent[0] || 'A');
    el.clock.textContent = txt('betaTime');
    el.hp.style.width = ($('betaHealth') && $('betaHealth').style.width) || '100%';
    el.st.style.width = ($('betaStamina') && $('betaStamina').style.width) || '100%';
    // lik
    el.crew.forEach(b => {
      const t = document.querySelector('[data-crew="' + b.dataset.c + '"]');
      b.classList.toggle('sel', !!t && t.classList.contains('selected'));
      b.classList.toggle('miss', !!t && (t.classList.contains('missing') || t.disabled && !t.classList.contains('selected')));
    });
    const storyOn = $('kb-story-interface') && !$('kb-story-interface').hidden;
    el.crew.forEach(b => { b.style.display = storyOn ? '' : 'none'; });
    // zadatak
    if (storyOn) {
      el.obj.hidden = false;
      el.oSm.textContent = txt('betaChapterNo') + (txt('betaChapterTitle') ? ' · ' + txt('betaChapterTitle') : '');
      el.oB.textContent = txt('betaTask');
      el.oD.textContent = txt('betaStoryDist');
      const ar = $('betaStoryArrow'); if (ar) el.oAr.style.transform = ar.style.transform || '';
      const pg = $('betaProgress'); if (pg) el.oPg.style.width = pg.style.width || '0%';
    } else {
      el.obj.hidden = false;
      el.oSm.textContent = 'Slobodna igra';
      el.oB.textContent = (txt('kbGeoArea').replace(/^Slobodna igra · /, '')) || 'Istražuj kraj';
      el.oD.textContent = ''; el.oAr.style.transform = ''; el.oPg.style.width = '0%';
    }
    // akcija
    const a = $('betaAction'), at = a ? a.textContent.trim() : '';
    const ready = !!at && !/^INTERAKCIJA\s*·\s*E$/i.test(at);
    el.go.classList.toggle('ready', ready);
    el.lbl.classList.toggle('on', ready); if (ready) el.lbl.textContent = at.replace(/\s*·\s*[A-Z]$/i, '');
    el.go.disabled = !!(a && a.disabled);
    // alati
    const lampT = txt('betaLamp'); el.lamp.classList.toggle('on', /DA/.test(lampT));
    const cz = h && h.cine && h.cine.crouch; el.crouch.classList.toggle('on', !!cz);
    const mv = (id, vis) => { const b = q('[data-m=' + id + ']'); if (b) b.hidden = !vis; };
    const ab = $('cineAbility'); el.ab1.style.display = (ab || riding()) ? '' : 'none';
    if (riding() !== el.ab1._r) { el.ab1._r = riding(); el.ab1.innerHTML = svg(el.ab1._r ? 'bike' : 'ability'); el.ab1.setAttribute('aria-label', el.ab1._r ? 'Zadnji točak' : 'Oprema'); }
    mv('mode', riding());
        const f = h && (h.football || h.interior);
    mv('repel', !!$('repel') && !$('repel').hidden && !f);

<script id="kb-beta2-version">window.KB_BETA2={version:"3.1.0",build:"v16-aaa-master"};</script>
<script id="kb-part2">/* Kalač Brdo · Drugi deo · ES2020 · bez mreže i dodatnih zavisnosti.
 * Učitati posle kb-real-world-runtime sa adapterom installPart2 v2.
 * Jedan tick pogona upravlja AI-em, talasima i zvukom. Nema novih rAF/interval petlji.
 */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const engine = window.KBBeta3D;
  if (!engine || typeof engine.installPart2 !== 'function') {
    throw new Error('Drugi deo zahteva priloženi adapter KBBeta3D.installPart2 v2.');
  }
  engine.installPart2(H => {
    if (H.version !== 2 || !window.KBQuickGames?.SignalLock) {
      throw new Error('Nedostaje kompatibilan pogon ili KBQuickGames.SignalLock.');
    }
    const {clamp, distance, $} = H, TAU = Math.PI * 2;
    const diagnostics = [], seenErrors = new Set();
    function note(code, error) {
      if (seenErrors.has(code)) return;
      seenErrors.add(code);
      diagnostics.push({code, message: String(error?.message || error), at: Date.now()});
      if (diagnostics.length > 32) diagnostics.shift();
    }

    // Prostorni sintetizator: svi glasovi idu preko jednog eksplicitnog master gain-a.
    function createAudio() {
      let ctx = null, master = null, noise = null, hum = [], motor = null, resume = null;
      const voices = new Set();
      function muted() {
        try { return localStorage.getItem('kb5_mute') === '1'; }
        catch (e) { note('audio-storage', e); return false; }
      }
      function position(node, p, y = .8) {
        const t = ctx.currentTime, yy = H.height(p.x, p.z) + y;
        if (node.positionX) {
          node.positionX.setValueAtTime(p.x, t);
          node.positionY.setValueAtTime(yy, t);
          node.positionZ.setValueAtTime(p.z, t);
        } else node.setPosition(p.x, yy, p.z);
      }
      function pan(p) {
        const n = ctx.createPanner();
        n.panningModel = 'HRTF'; n.distanceModel = 'inverse';
        n.refDistance = 4; n.maxDistance = 100; n.rolloffFactor = 1.2;
        position(n, p); n.connect(master);
        return n;
      }
      function continuous(frequency, p, type = 'sine') {
        const oscillator = ctx.createOscillator(), gain = ctx.createGain();
        const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter(), spatial = pan(p);
        oscillator.type = type; oscillator.frequency.value = frequency;
        gain.gain.value = 0; filter.type = 'lowpass'; filter.frequency.value = 1800;
        oscillator.connect(gain); gain.connect(filter); filter.connect(spatial); oscillator.start();
        return {oscillator, gain, filter, spatial};
      }
      function init() {
        if (!ctx) {
          const Audio = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
          if (!Audio) { note('audio-unavailable', 'Web Audio nije dostupan. Tekst i mehanike ostaju aktivni.'); return null; }
          try {
            ctx = new Audio(); master = ctx.createGain();
            master.gain.value = muted() ? 0 : .75; master.connect(ctx.destination);
            noise = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate, ctx.sampleRate);
            const samples = noise.getChannelData(0); let brown = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
              const white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
              brown = (brown + white * .08) / 1.03;
              samples[i] = brown * .6 + white * .23;
            }
            hum = [62, 124].map(f => continuous(f, H.locations[8]));
            motor = continuous(90, H.actors[H.active], 'triangle');
          } catch (e) { note('audio-init', e); suspend(); return ctx; }
        }
        if (ctx.state === 'suspended' && !resume) {
          resume = ctx.resume().catch(e => note('audio-resume', e)).finally(() => { resume = null; });
        }
        return ctx;
      }
      function oneShot({frequency = 120, end = 70, duration = .2, volume = .05,
        type = 'triangle', at = null, noisy = false, cutoff = 1100, rate = 1}) {
        if (!ctx || ctx.state !== 'running' || voices.size >= 24 || muted()) return;
        const t = ctx.currentTime, source = noisy ? ctx.createBufferSource() : ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain(), filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter(), spatial = at ? pan(at) : null;
        if (noisy) { source.buffer = noise; source.playbackRate.value = rate; }
        else {
          source.type = type; source.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, t);
          source.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, end), t + duration);
        }
        filter.type = 'lowpass'; filter.frequency.value = cutoff;
        if (at && !H.lineClear(H.actors[H.active], at, .1)) { filter.frequency.value *= .35; volume *= .45; }
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, t);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.0002, volume), t + Math.min(.02, duration / 4));
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, t + duration);
        source.connect(filter); filter.connect(gain); gain.connect(spatial || master);
        const record = {source, clean() {
          source.disconnect(); filter.disconnect(); gain.disconnect(); spatial?.disconnect(); voices.delete(record);
        }};
        voices.add(record); source.onended = record.clean;
        source.start(t); source.stop(t + duration + .02);
      }
      function step(gain=1) {
        const p = H.actors[H.active], surface = H.groundMaterial(p.x, p.z);
        const profiles = {asphalt:[850,.055,.12,115], gravel:[2900,.105,.16,160], grass:[430,.09,.10,75], mud:[210,.14,.14,58]};
        const [cutoff, duration, volume, frequency] = profiles[surface];
        oneShot({noisy:true, cutoff, duration, volume:volume*gain*(p.move>5?1.15:.8), rate:surface==='mud'?.7:1});
        oneShot({frequency, end:frequency*.45, duration, volume:.017*gain, type:'sine'});
        H.scene.dataset.surface = surface;
      }
      const specs = {
        switch:[180,860,.48,.024,'sine'], flare:[280,80,.55,.04,'sawtooth'],
        interference:[95,240,.4,.035,'triangle'], horn:[125,105,.65,.05,'sawtooth'],
        kick:[155,48,.09,.07,'triangle'], bounce:[105,55,.07,.035,'sine'], bump:[90,35,.16,.06,'triangle'],
        repel:[1600,2600,.42,.035,'sine'], flash:[650,1900,.16,.025,'sine'], clue:[580,1160,.26,.035,'sine'],
        goal:[330,990,.7,.045,'triangle'], whistle:[1550,1800,.4,.03,'sine']
      };
      function play(kind, volume = 1, at = null) {
        if (kind === 'step') { step(volume); return; }
        if (kind === 'bark' || kind === 'growl') {
          at = at || H.actors[H.active];
          oneShot({noisy:true, at, duration:kind==='bark'?.29:.55, cutoff:kind==='bark'?780:290,
            rate:kind==='bark'?.8:.5, volume:volume*(kind==='bark'?.14:.065)});
          oneShot({at, frequency:kind==='bark'?185:90, end:kind==='bark'?68:63, duration:kind==='bark'?.25:.5,
            volume:volume*.025, type:'sawtooth', cutoff:500}); return;
        }
        const [frequency, end, duration, gain, type] = specs[kind] || specs.clue;
        oneShot({frequency,end,duration,volume:gain*volume,type,at,cutoff:Math.max(1800,frequency*2)});
        if (kind === 'kick') oneShot({noisy:true, duration:.04, volume:.025*volume, cutoff:1600, at});
      }
      function accordion(dist) {
        const melody=[293.66,349.23,440,392,349.23,329.63,293.66,261.63];
        const frequency=melody[Math.floor(H.time/.36)%melody.length];
        for (const [harm, v] of [[1,1],[2,.28],[3,.13]]) oneShot({frequency:frequency*harm,end:frequency*harm,
          duration:.34,volume:.023*v*clamp(1-dist/65,0,1),type:'sawtooth',at:H.locations[3]});
      }
      function update() {
        if (!ctx || ctx.state !== 'running' || !master) return;
        const t=ctx.currentTime, p=H.actors[H.active], listener=ctx.listener, y=H.height(p.x,p.z)+1.6;
        master.gain.setTargetAtTime(muted()||(H.paused&&!H.mini)||document.hidden?0:.75,t,.035);
        if (listener.positionX) {
          for (const [key,value] of Object.entries({positionX:p.x,positionY:y,positionZ:p.z,
            forwardX:Math.sin(H.yaw),forwardY:0,forwardZ:Math.cos(H.yaw),upX:0,upY:1,upZ:0})) listener[key].setValueAtTime(value,t);
        } else { listener.setPosition(p.x,y,p.z); listener.setOrientation(Math.sin(H.yaw),0,Math.cos(H.yaw),0,1,0); }
        const station=H.locations[8], blocked=!H.lineClear(p,{x:station.x,z:station.z+4},.1);
        const volume=H.paused||H.interior||H.football?0:clamp(1-distance(p,station)/65,0,1);
        hum.forEach((n,i)=>{n.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(volume*(i?.025:.055),t,.15);
          n.filter.frequency.setTargetAtTime(blocked?320:1800,t,.15);});
        if (motor) {
          const speed=Math.abs(H.ride.speed), on=H.ride.kind===2&&H.ride.battery>0&&!H.interior&&!H.football&&!H.paused;
          position(motor.spatial,p,.45);
          motor.oscillator.frequency.setTargetAtTime(70+speed*28,t,.06);
          motor.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(on&&speed>.1?.012+Math.min(.045,speed*.003):0,t,.08);
        }
      }
      function suspend() {
        for (const v of [...voices]) { try { v.source.stop(); } catch(e) { note('audio-stop',e); } v.clean(); }
        if (ctx && ctx.state !== 'closed') ctx.suspend().catch(e=>note('audio-suspend',e));
      }
      return {init,play,accordion,update,suspend,get stats(){return {contexts:ctx?1:0,transient:voices.size,continuous:hum.length+(motor?1:0),muted:muted()};}};
    }
    const audio=createAudio();

    // Čopor pamti poslednji viđeni položaj. Senzori rade do 4 puta/s, kretanje na tick-u.
    let senses=new WeakMap(), barkAt=0, alertAt=0, lastEvent='';
    function updateDogs(dt) {
      if (H.interior || H.football) return;
      const dogs=H.dogs, player=H.actors[H.active], night=H.dusk>.48;
      for(let i=0;i<dogs.length;i++) {
        const d=dogs[i]; if(H.story.on&&!d.mission)continue;
        let brain=senses.get(d);
        if(!brain){brain={sense:0,seenUntil:0,role:i%3,last:{x:d.hx,z:d.hz},goal:{x:d.x,z:d.z}};senses.set(d,brain);}
        d.attack=Math.max(0,(d.attack||0)-dt); d.fear=Math.max(0,(d.fear||0)-dt); d.timer=(d.timer||0)-dt;
        const lure=d.mission&&H.cine&&H.time<H.cine.guardUntil&&distance(d,H.actors[0])<16&&H.lineClear(d,H.actors[0],.2);
        const target=d.mission?(lure?H.actors[0]:H.actors[1]):player, range=distance(d,target);
        if(range>85&&!d.mission&&d.state!=='return'){d.move=0;continue;}
        if(H.time>=brain.sense){
          brain.sense=H.time+.25+(i%4)*.035;
          const yardOK=!d.yard||distance(target,{x:d.hx,z:d.hz})<8;
          const quiet=!!H.cine?.crouch&&target===player,canSee=range<(night?21:7)*(quiet&&!H.torch?.57:1)&&yardOK&&H.lineClear(d,target,.24);
          const hears=yardOK&&range<(target.move>5?13:target.move>1?7:0)*(quiet?.31:1);
          if(canSee||hears||d.mission){brain.last={x:target.x,z:target.z};brain.seenUntil=H.time+4;}
          if(d.fear>0)d.state='flee';
          else if(brain.seenUntil>H.time&&yardOK)d.state='chase';
          else if(d.state==='chase'||d.state==='flee')d.state='return';
          if(d.state==='chase'){
            const lead=brain.role===2?clamp(range/7,0,1.25):.35, dx=target.x-d.x,dz=target.z-d.z,L=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;
            const flank=range>3?(brain.role===0?-1:brain.role===1?1:0)*Math.min(3,range*.22):0;
            const vx=canSee||d.mission?(target.vx||0):0,vz=canSee||d.mission?(target.vz||0):0;
            brain.goal={x:brain.last.x+vx*lead+dz/L*flank,z:brain.last.z+vz*lead-dx/L*flank};
          }
        }
        let goal=brain.goal,speed=.9;
        if(d.fear>0){d.state='flee';const dx=d.x-target.x,dz=d.z-target.z,L=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;
          goal={x:d.x+(L===1&&dx===0?1:dx/L)*12,z:d.z+dz/L*12};speed=5.9;}
        else if(d.state==='chase'){
          speed=night?5.15:3.8;
          if(range<1.25&&d.attack<=0&&H.lineClear(d,target,.18)){
            d.attack=1.5;target.hp=Math.max(0,target.hp-7);if(target===player)H.hurt=.7;audio.play('bark',1,d);
            if(H.time>alertAt){alertAt=H.time+5;H.say('Lazar','Drži odstojanje! Andrej, odvuci ih svetlom. R uključuje rasterivač.',4);}
            if(target.hp<=0){H.story.on?H.missionFail('Čopor je prekinuo skeniranje. Ekipa se povukla do telefona.'):H.respawn();return;}
          }
        } else if(d.state==='return'){
          goal={x:d.hx,z:d.hz};speed=2;if(distance(d,goal)<1.5){d.state='patrol';d.timer=0;}
        } else {
          if(d.timer<=0||!d.goal){const a=Math.random()*TAU,r=d.yard?2.2:6;
            d.goal=H.clearSpot({x:d.hx+Math.sin(a)*r,z:d.hz+Math.cos(a)*r},.28);d.timer=5+Math.random()*6;}
          goal=d.goal;
        }
        if(d.yard){const L=distance(goal,{x:d.hx,z:d.hz});if(L>7)goal={x:d.hx+(goal.x-d.hx)/L*7,z:d.hz+(goal.z-d.hz)/L*7};}
        // Razdvajanje suseda sprečava gomilanje; svi pomaci ostaju u kolizionom pogonu.
        let sx=0,sz=0;
        for(const other of dogs){if(other===d)continue;const dx=d.x-other.x,dz=d.z-other.z,L=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
          if(L>.001&&L<1.05){sx+=dx/L*(1.05-L);sz+=dz/L*(1.05-L);}}
        const previous={x:d.x,z:d.z};
        d.repath=d.repath||0;d.stuck=d.stuck||0;d.path=d.path||[];
        const direct=distance(d,goal);
        if(direct>.25&&H.lineClear(d,goal,.28)){
          const travel=Math.min(direct,speed*dt);
          H.moveBody(d,(goal.x-d.x)/direct*travel,(goal.z-d.z)/direct*travel,.28);
          d.phase=(d.phase||0)+travel*6;
        } else if(direct>.25) H.follower(d,goal,dt,speed);
        H.moveBody(d,sx*dt*2,sz*dt*2,.28);
        d.move=distance(previous,d)/dt;
        if(d.move>.03)d.yaw=H.angleLerp(d.yaw||0,Math.atan2(d.x-previous.x,d.z-previous.z),Math.min(1,dt*7));
        if(range<17&&d.fear<=0&&H.time>barkAt){audio.play(range<6?'growl':'bark',clamp(1-range/23,.15,1),d);barkAt=H.time+1.8+Math.random()*2.8;}
      }
    }

    // Pravi presek dve dijagonalne staze; ne aproksimacija centroidom parka.
    function parkCrossing(){
      const paths=H.park.paths;
      for(let i=0;i<paths.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<paths.length;j++)
        for(let a=1;a<paths[i].length;a++)for(let b=1;b<paths[j].length;b++){
          const A=paths[i][a-1],B=paths[i][a],C=paths[j][b-1],D=paths[j][b];
          const rx=B[0]-A[0],rz=B[1]-A[1],sx=D[0]-C[0],sz=D[1]-C[1],den=rx*sz-rz*sx;
          if(Math.abs(den)<1e-7)continue;
          const t=((C[0]-A[0])*sz-(C[1]-A[1])*sx)/den,u=((C[0]-A[0])*rz-(C[1]-A[1])*rx)/den;
          if(t>.01&&t<.99&&u>.01&&u<.99)return {x:A[0]+rx*t,z:A[1]+rz*t};
        }
      note('park-crossing','U podacima nije pronađen unutrašnji presek; koristi se označeni centar.');
      return H.parkCenter;
    }

    // Put patrole prati povezane OSM segmente jedne ulice, bez presecanja kuća.
    let routeStreet='Njegoševa',covers=[];
    function patrolPath(){
      const player=H.actors[H.active],names=['Njegoševa','Durmitorska'];
      routeStreet=names.map(name=>({name,d:Math.min(...H.segments.filter(s=>s.road.name===name).map(s=>H.segDist(player.x,player.z,s.a,s.b)))})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d)[0].name;
      const nodes=new Map();
      function node(p){const key=p[0].toFixed(3)+','+p[1].toFixed(3);if(!nodes.has(key))nodes.set(key,{x:p[0],z:p[1],edges:new Set()});return nodes.get(key);}
      for(const s of H.segments.filter(s=>s.road.name===routeStreet)){const a=node(s.a),b=node(s.b);a.edges.add(b);b.edges.add(a);}
      const nearest=[...nodes.values()].sort((a,b)=>distance(a,player)-distance(b,player))[0];if(!nearest)return [];
      const component=[nearest],visited=new Set(component);
      for(let i=0;i<component.length;i++)for(const n of component[i].edges)if(!visited.has(n)){visited.add(n);component.push(n);}
      component.sort((a,b)=>a.z-b.z);const from=component[0],to=component[component.length-1],queue=[from],prev=new Map([[from,null]]);
      for(let i=0;i<queue.length&&!prev.has(to);i++)for(const n of queue[i].edges)if(!prev.has(n)){prev.set(n,queue[i]);queue.push(n);}
      if(!prev.has(to))return [];const path=[];for(let n=to;n;n=prev.get(n))path.push({x:n.x,z:n.z});path.reverse();
      if(H.height(path[0].x,path[0].z)<H.height(path[path.length-1].x,path[path.length-1].z))path.reverse();
      // Lokalni odsek do 220 m; auto ostaje u vidljivom događaju i završava prolazak.
      let near=0;for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++)if(distance(path[i],player)<distance(path[near],player))near=i;
      let lo=near,hi=near,len=0;while(lo>0&&len<90){len+=distance(path[lo],path[lo-1]);lo--;}
      len=0;while(hi<path.length-1&&len<130){len+=distance(path[hi],path[hi+1]);hi++;}
      return path.slice(lo,hi+1);
    }
    function pickEvent(){
      const p=H.actors[H.active],near=distance(p,H.locations[3])<80?'accordion':distance(p,H.parkCenter)<140?'patrol':'derby';
      const pool=['patrol','accordion',...(distance(p,H.field)<75?['derby']:[]),near==='derby'?'patrol':near].filter(t=>t!==lastEvent);
      lastEvent=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];return lastEvent;
    }
    function carDistance(p,car){
      const dx=p.x-car.x,dz=p.z-car.z,c=Math.cos(car.yaw),s=Math.sin(car.yaw);
      return Math.hypot(Math.max(0,Math.abs(dx*c-dz*s)-.9),Math.max(0,Math.abs(dx*s+dz*c)-2.1));
    }
    function prepareCover(event){
      covers=[];
      const player=H.actors[H.active],segments=H.segments.filter(s=>s.road.name===routeStreet).sort((a,b)=>H.segDist(player.x,player.z,a.a,a.b)-H.segDist(player.x,player.z,b.a,b.b));
      for(const seg of segments){
        const dx=seg.b[0]-seg.a[0],dz=seg.b[1]-seg.a[1],L=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(L<6)continue;
        for(const side of [-1,1]){
          const offset=seg.road.width/2+2,car={x:(seg.a[0]+seg.b[0])/2+dz/L*offset*side,z:(seg.a[1]+seg.b[1])/2-dx/L*offset*side,yaw:Math.atan2(dx,dz),kind:'car'};
          if(covers.some(c=>distance(c,car)<7)||distance(player,car)<3)continue;
          let clear=true;
          for(const x of [-1,0,1])for(const z of [-2.2,0,2.2]){const px=car.x+x*Math.cos(car.yaw)+z*Math.sin(car.yaw),pz=car.z-x*Math.sin(car.yaw)+z*Math.cos(car.yaw);if(H.collide(px,pz,.12))clear=false;}
          if(clear)covers.push(car);if(covers.length===2)break;
        }
        if(covers.length===2)break;
      }
      event.line='Patrolni auto prolazi '+(routeStreet==='Njegoševa'?'Njegoševom':'Durmitorskom')+'. L: ugasi lampu. Z: čučni iza žive ograde ili parkiranog auta.';
      const banner=$('kbKom');if(banner){banner.textContent='KOMISIJA · L: lampa · Z: čučanj';banner.classList.add('on');}
    }
    function coverCollision(x,z,r){return !!H.event&&H.event.type==='patrol'&&covers.some(c=>carDistance({x,z},c)<r);}
    function isHidden(player,patrol){
      if(H.torch||!H.cine?.crouch||player.move>=.65)return false;
      if(!H.lineClear(player,patrol,.10))return true;
      if(H.mission?.bushes.some(b=>distance(player,b)<2.7))return true;
      return covers.some(c=>{
        if(carDistance(player,c)>2.2)return false;
        const cs=Math.cos(c.yaw),sn=Math.sin(c.yaw),dx=player.x-c.x,dz=player.z-c.z;
        const origin=[dx*cs-dz*sn,dx*sn+dz*cs],vx=patrol.x-player.x,vz=patrol.z-player.z;
        const delta=[vx*cs-vz*sn,vx*sn+vz*cs],extent=[.9,2.1];let lo=0,hi=1;
        for(let k=0;k<2;k++){
          if(Math.abs(delta[k])<1e-8){if(Math.abs(origin[k])>extent[k])return false;}
          else {let a=(-extent[k]-origin[k])/delta[k],b=(extent[k]-origin[k])/delta[k];if(a>b)[a,b]=[b,a];lo=Math.max(lo,a);hi=Math.min(hi,b);if(lo>hi)return false;}
        }
        return hi>0&&lo<1;
      });
    }
    function paintCovers(mesh){if(H.event?.type!=='patrol')return;for(const c of covers)if(distance(c,H.actors[H.active])<100)H.patrolCarModel(mesh,c);}
    function paintPlanCovers(c,scale){if(H.event?.type!=='patrol')return;for(const car of covers){const p=H.planProject(car.x,car.z);c.save();c.translate(...p);c.scale(1,.78);c.rotate(-car.yaw);c.fillStyle='#253742';c.fillRect(-.9*scale,-2.1*scale,1.8*scale,4.2*scale);c.fillStyle='#72909b';c.fillRect(-.7*scale,-.85*scale,1.4*scale,.55*scale);c.restore();}}

    function tick(dt){
      const cine=H.cine;
      if(cine?.tuning&&lock){
        if(H.active!==1||!H.story.on||H.task?.type!=='resonance'){H.closeTuner();return;}
        if(lockOwner!==cine||lockChannel!==cine.requiredTune)newLock();
        if(distance(H.actors[1],H.mission.pads[1])<3.4&&H.lightAt(H.actors[1]))lock.step(dt);
        else {lock.elapsed+=dt;lock.progress=Math.max(0,lock.progress-dt*.7);if(lock.elapsed>=lock.duration)lock.state='expired';}
        if(lock.state==='decoded'){H.finishTune();}
        else if(H.time>=tuneDraw){
          tuneDraw=H.time+(document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco')?.1:.05);
          const canvas=$('cineSignalCanvas');H.drawSignalLock(canvas.getContext('2d'),canvas.width,canvas.height,lock);
          const target=lock.target();$('cineTuneTarget').textContent='PRIJEMNIK · '+target.frequency.toFixed(2)+' Hz';
          $('cineSignalState').textContent=lock.state==='expired'?'VEZA PREKINUTA · ponovi očitavanje':
            'SIGNAL '+Math.floor(lock.progress/2.5*100)+'% · '+Math.max(0,Math.ceil(lock.duration-lock.elapsed))+' s';
          $('cineSignalRetry').hidden=lock.state!=='expired';canvas.dataset.state=lock.state;
        }
      }
      if(cine?.wire?.open&&H.time>wireStepAt){wireStepAt=H.time+1.7+Math.random()*1.8;
        const p=H.mission.repair;audio.play('growl',.5,{x:p.x+8,z:p.z+7});audio.play('bump',.35,{x:p.x-5,z:p.z+6});}
      if(H.time>nextUi){nextUi=H.time+.12;crouch.hidden=!!H.football;crouch.textContent=cine?.crouch?'USTANI · Z':'ČUČNI · Z';crouch.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!!cine?.crouch));
        if(!H.event&&covers.length){covers=[];$('kbKom')?.classList.remove('on');}}
    }
    let nextUi=0;
    function stop(){closeTuner();lock=null;lockOwner=null;senses=new WeakMap();covers=[];barkAt=alertAt=nextUi=wireStepAt=0;audio.suspend();$('kbKom')?.classList.remove('on');}
    const publicAPI=Object.freeze({version:'2.0.0',get diagnostics(){return diagnostics.slice();},get audio(){return audio.stats;},
      get status(){return {tuning:!!H.cine?.tuning,signal:lock?.state||null,patrolStreet:routeStreet,covers:covers.length};}});
    return {version:2,publicAPI,audio,updateDogs,parkCrossing,openTuner,closeTuner,tunerKey,patrolPath,pickEvent,
      prepareCover,coverCollision,isHidden,paintCovers,paintPlanCovers,tick,stop};
  });
})();
</script>
